The Combined Commentary on the Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha’s New Flower Ornament Scripture, Fascicle Fourteen.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda, a Śramaṇa from Khotan during the Tang Dynasty;
the commentary composed by Li Tongxuan, a Lay Elder of Fangshan in Taiyuan during the Tang Dynasty.
Compiled by the Śramaṇa Zhining of Kaiyuan Temple in Fuzhou during the Tang Dynasty, Collating the Scriptures and Combining the Treatises:
*The World-Ruling Sovereigns’ Sublime Adornment*, Chapter One, Part Seven [Treatise]:
From among the great assembly surrounding and constantly following the Buddha’s retinue, from Samantabhadra Bodhisattva down to the Great...

The forty-one assemblies that have already appeared are divided into two parts: first, the section that manifests the results as causes to clarify their positions (as in the preceding list of assemblies);

second, the section that proceeds from position to raise up the dharmas for further cultivation, based on the shared attainment of benefits (as follows, down to Samantabhadra, Sāgaracandraprabha, and so forth).
Now, following the second part, at the beginning of this fascicle: "At that time, the ocean-like assembly at the Tathāgata’s site of enlightenment..."

"Having all gathered like clouds," from here down to the assembly of the Bodhisattva Samudrareṇu-prabha in the fifth fascicle—these forty-one assemblies represent the stages of advancement through the Dharma based on their respective positions; they are presented as sharing common benefits.
Within this, there are fifty assemblies in total, including the ten Bodhisattvas such as Samantabhadra, who correspond to the stage of Equal Enlightenment (*samyak-saṃbodhi*).
The eleven stages of the Dharma-gate consist of ten elements that mutually interpenetrate, naturally forming ten assemblies within a single person; these ten collectively constitute fifty assemblies.
As explained in the section on "Attaining Benefits," entering [this state] means one’s knowledge and vision become identical to those of a Buddha.

This serves as a model for later students so that they may emulate it. Those who do not realize this remain ordinary beings; those who realize it find their own knowledge and vision identical to those of a Buddha.

Therefore, it is said that "at the very moment of first generating the mind of enlightenment, one attains perfect awakening. In the section concerning the gods who descended from heaven to receive benefits, there are twenty verses each;

the first two lines of each praise the Buddha’s virtues, while the subsequent eighteen lines consist of three phrases praising the Buddha and one phrase expressing the speaker’s own realization that they are equal to the Buddha.
One should understand the pattern to be thus, and categorize them accordingly as the occasion requires.
The text praises each according to its respective occasion, so there is no need for further explanation. Only the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra alone enters the ten dharmas;
this is because Samantabhadra represents the single stage of universal illumination that pervades all practices.

The "Assembly of Moonlight on the Ocean" merely praises the Buddha’s virtues, which correspond to the dharmas he himself has entered; therefore, within these verses, he does not separately praise his own qualities.
Regarding the virtue [of Samantabhadra], among the assembly there is added the Bodhisattva Pure Virtue Subtle Light (Jingde Miaoguang). Mañjuśrī is an alternative name for this;
"Mañjuśrī" translates here as "Subtle Virtue" (Miaode). Furthermore, within the *Saddharmapuṇḍarīka-sūtra*, his former name was "Subtle Light" (Miaoguang).
Thus, the meanings of "Subtle Virtue" and "Light" are similar: virtue constitutes light, for it is capable of destroying darkness and manifesting brilliance.
Therefore, being now within the assembly of Samantabhadra, he manifests that the cause and effect, wisdom and prajñā, and the myriad practices are perfectly interfused.

Thus, the fact that Samantabhadra alone obtains the ten kinds of benefits clarifies that "one is all," and clarifies the mastery over the one and the many, as well as freedom in the extension and contraction [of time].
This is the meaning of universal subsumption.

[Sūtra] At that time, the ocean-like assembly at the Tathāgata’s place of enlightenment had already gathered like clouds; beings of boundless categories surrounded him in every direction, their forms, colors, and retinues each distinct.
From whichever quarter they had come, they drew near to the World-Honored One and gazed upon him with single-minded devotion.
This entire assembly had already abandoned all defilements of mental afflictions along with their residual habits, having crushed their heavy obstructions.

The mountain beholds the Buddha without obstruction; all this is because, in times past during oceans of kalpas, Vairocana Tathāgata cultivated the bodhisattva practices and gathered beings through the four means of attraction (*saṃgrahavastu*).

At each stage of his encounters with every Buddha, he planted roots of goodness, which were all skillfully gathered through various expedient means of teaching and maturation, establishing them firmly in the Dharma.

Having fully attained the immeasurable paths of omniscience and the various modes of knowledge, they have acquired a vast multitude of great merits and have entirely entered the ocean of vows of skillful means.
Their practiced conduct is perfectly pure, and they have successfully emerged upon the path of renunciation. Constantly beholding the Buddhas, they perceive them with clear illumination;
through the power of resolute conviction, they enter the great ocean of the Tathāgatas' merits and attain the liberation of all Buddhas.

The gate of liberation for sporting in supernatural powers is that of the Great Lord of Heaven, Ocean of Sublime Flames, who has attained the power of skillful means for the tranquility of the dharma-realm and the realm of empty space;
the gate of liberation for universal observation of all phenomena with complete mastery is that of the Heavenly King Light of Sovereign Renown;
and the gate of liberation for knowing oneness is that of the Heavenly King Eye of Pure Merit.
The liberation door of the effortless practice of all phenomena being neither arising nor ceasing, neither coming nor going;
the liberation door of the ocean of wisdom that directly perceives the true reality of all phenomena, attained by the Celestial King Great Wisdom Delightful;
and the liberation door of the samādhi of great skillful means that bestows boundless peace and happiness upon sentient beings, attained by the Celestial King Sovereign Immutable Light.
The Celestial King Wondrously Adorned Eye attained the liberation door of causing the observation of the dharma of tranquility to extinguish all darkness of ignorance and fear;
the Celestial King Light of Excellent Contemplation attained the liberation door of skillfully entering boundless realms and not giving rise to thoughts of karma regarding any existence;
the Celestial King Great Wisdom Delightful attained the [liberation door] of universally proceeding to the ten directions to preach...
The celestial king Universal Sound Adorned Banner attained the liberation door of being unmoved within the Dharma and having no basis for reliance;
the celestial king Renowned Light of Excellent Diligence attained the liberation door of universally manifesting radiance within the tranquil realm of the Buddha;

and [the celestial king] Attained Abiding in One’s Own Realization attained the liberation door of dwelling in the place of one's own awakening while taking infinite and vast realms as the object of focus. Thus it was.
At that time, the Celestial King Sublime Flame-Ocean, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of the Sovereign Heavens (*Īśvara-deva*) and spoke in verse.
[Treatise] 1. From the passage "At that time, from within the ocean-like assembly at the Tathāgata’s site of enlightenment" onwards, there are twenty-six lines of scripture.
(441 words) The meaning is divided into two parts. First, from the initial "At that time" (*tadā*) onwards, there are eleven lines of scripture clarifying that the assembly has already gathered.
Within this section, there are five points of meaning: 1. Describing the gathering of the assembly; 2. Describing the distinct categories [of the assembly];
3. Universally praising the virtues of the assembly; 4. Clarifying their original causes through the Buddha’s transformation; 5. Clarifying...
Now, by the power of resolute conviction (*adhimukti*), one enters the second section of what is known by the Buddha;

from the point "the Great Lord of the Heaven of the Ocean of Wondrous Flames" (*Sudharmā-samudra-mahā-īśvara-rāja*) downwards, there are fifteen lines of scripture. Within this passage, there are two points of meaning:
first, to clarify the benefits obtained by the Heavenly King; second, to clarify how the Heavenly King, riding upon [the Buddha's] majestic power, speaks the verses.
[Sūtra] The Buddha’s body pervades all great assemblies, filling the dharma-realm without end.
It is quiescent, devoid of self-nature, and ungraspable; it appears for the sake of saving the world.
The Tathāgata, the Dharma King who has transcended the world, is able to kindle the wondrous lamp of the Dharma that illuminates the world.
The realms are boundless and inexhaustible; this is what is realized by the name "Mastery.

The Buddha is inconceivable and free from conceptualization; having understood that the ten directions are non-existent, He widely opens the pure path for the world; such a pure eye is able to behold it all.
The Tathāgata’s wisdom is boundless; no one in any world can fathom it.
It forever extinguishes the ignorant and darkened minds of sentient beings. With great wisdom, he enters and dwells securely in this profundity.
The Tathāgata’s merits are inconceivable; those who see him have their afflictions extinguished.

May all in the world obtain peace and happiness; The sovereign Lord Acala can perceive that sentient beings are constantly deluded and obscured by the darkness of ignorance. The Tathāgata preaches for them the Dharma of tranquility;
this is the lamp of wisdom that illuminates the world. One with wondrous eyes can understand these skillful means.
The Tathāgata’s pure and wondrous form-body appears universally throughout the ten directions, peerless;
this body is without intrinsic nature and has no place of dependence, as observed by the god Sunimitta.
The Tathāgata’s voice is without limit or obstruction; among those capable of being transformed, there are none who do not hear it.
Yet the Buddha remains serene and eternally unmoving; this is the liberation of the Joyful Wisdom Deva, the tranquil liberation of the Lord of Devas.
Nowhere in the ten directions does he not appear before them;
his radiant light shines forth, filling the world. This is the Unobstructed Dharma Adorned Banner whom I behold.

Throughout an ocean of boundless great kalpas, for the sake of sentient beings, the Buddha sought awakening and transformed all through various supernormal powers; the deity Renowned Light realized this Dharma.
[Commentary: Within these twenty lines of verse there are two meanings; first, the initial two lines purely offer praise.
The twenty-eighth section on the Buddha’s virtues consists of verses, each with three lines praising the Buddha and one line expressing self-praise for being equal to the Buddha in knowledge;
the subsequent sections follow this pattern, with the exception that the section on Samantabhadra differs slightly from the preceding. The intended meaning has already been set forth above.

[Sūtra] Furthermore, the Celestial King Banner of the Radiance of Dharma Delightful to Behold attained the liberation door of universally observing the faculties of all sentient beings to preach the Dharma and sever doubts;
the Celestial King Pure Adornment Ocean attained the liberation door of causing Buddhas to appear according to recollection;
and the Celestial King Light of Supreme Wisdom attained the liberation door of the equality of the dharma-nature, which is without dependence.

The Celestial King Sovereign Wisdom Banner of Liberation through Adorning the Body attained the liberation door of knowing all worldly dharmas and establishing inconceivable oceans of adornments within a single thought-moment;
the Celestial King Joy in Quiescence attained the liberation door of manifesting inconceivable Buddha-lands within a single pore without obstruction; and the Celestial King Universal Wisdom Eye...
King Entry into the Universal Gate Observing the Dharma Realm attained the liberation door of the Joyful Revolution of Wisdom;

King Boundless Eon Constant Manifestation Appearing in Various Ways for All Sentient Beings attained the liberation door of the Inconceivable Dharma Entered by Contemplating All Worldly Realms; and King Light of Good Seed Wisdom attained the liberation door of... [the text ends here].
The Celestial King Stainless Tranquil Light attained the liberation door of demonstrating the dharma of the essential exit for all sentient beings;
the Celestial King Vast Pure Light attained the liberation door of observing all responsive and transformed sentient beings and causing them to enter the Buddha-dharma.
At that time, the Celestial King Banner of the Radiance of Delightful Dharmas, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, universally surveyed all.
The assemblies of the Śuddhāvāsa, Avrha, Atapa, and Sudṛśa heavens spoke these verses:
"The realm of the Buddhas is inconceivable; No sentient beings can fathom it.
May they all give rise to faith and understanding; Their vast resolve is inexhaustible."
If there are sentient beings capable of receiving the Dharma,
the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power guides them so that they may constantly behold the Buddha appearing before them.
Just as the Sea-Adornment Heavenly King thus perceives all dharmas as having no basis, so too does the Buddha appear in the world.
Universally throughout all states of existence, there is no place of reliance; this meaning can be observed through superior wisdom.

According to the desires of the minds of all sentient beings, the Buddha’s power of spiritual transformations can manifest each and every inconceivable distinction—this is the ocean of liberation of the King of Wisdom Banners.
All the lands that existed in the past are manifested within a single pore;

this is the great supernormal power of the Buddhas. Those who delight in tranquility can proclaim this inexhaustible ocean of all dharma-gates, gathered together in the site of enlightenment of a single Dharma.
Such is the nature of phenomena as taught by the Buddha; The eye of wisdom can clarify this skillful means.
In all the lands throughout the ten directions, He preaches the Dharma within them all.
The Buddha-body neither goes nor comes; It is the realm of the revolving wheel of loving joy and wisdom.

The Buddha observes the phenomena of the world as being like reflections and shadows; Entering those most profound and subtle depths, he teaches that the nature of all dharmas is eternally quiescent. Those with virtuous seeds who contemplate well can perceive this;
The Buddha thoroughly understands all realms and, according to the faculties of sentient beings, rains down the rain of Dharma.
To open the gateway to the inconceivable means of liberation, this Śāntadeva is able to enter [into it];
the World-Honored One always manifests with great compassion to benefit sentient beings,
raining down the Dharma equally to fill their vessels, while Viśuddhaprabhadeva is able to expound it.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Pure Wisdom and Renown attained the liberation door of skillful means for penetrating the path of liberation of all sentient beings;
the Celestial King Supreme Vision attained the liberation door of manifesting universally like reflections and shadows according to the inclinations of all the celestial hosts;
and the Celestial King Tranquil Virtue attained the universal adornment and purification of all Buddha-realms.
The Celestial King Sumeru-voice attained the liberation door of following all sentient beings as they perpetually circulate through the ocean of birth and death;
the Celestial King Pure-Mind-Eye attained the liberation door of recollecting the Tathāgata’s practices for taming sentient beings;
and the Celestial King Delightful-Universal-Illumination attained the flow from the ocean of the *dhāraṇī* of universal gates.
The World-Honored Lord of Devas, Sovereign of Liberation, attained the liberation door of enabling sentient beings to encounter the Buddha and give rise to faith;
the Deva King Sovereign of Radiant Flames attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings to hear the Dharma with faith and joy and thereby achieve transcendence;
the Deva King of Transformation, Joyful Contemplation of the Dharma, attained entry into all Bodhi...
The Celestial King Banner of Transformation attained the liberation door of subduing beings through conduct as boundless and inexhaustible as space;

the Celestial King Sublime Adornment of Stellar Sound attained the liberation door of emitting light to manifest the three wheels of the Buddha’s conversion and guidance; at that time, the Celestial King Renowned for Pure Wisdom...
The Celestial King, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the assemblies of the Parīttābha, Apramāṇābha,
and Ābhāsvara devas and spoke these verses:
“Those who thoroughly understand the unimpeded nature of phenomena Manifest throughout the infinite lands of the ten directions.”
He speaks of the inconceivable realm of the Buddha, Causing all beings to return together to the ocean of liberation.
The Tathāgata dwells in the world without dependence, Like light or a shadow appearing in all lands.
The nature of phenomena is ultimately without arising; This is the gateway entered by King Vimaladarśana.
Having cultivated skillful means for an ocean of immeasurable eons, He universally purifies all lands throughout the ten directions;
The Dharma-realm is suchness, eternally unmoving— This is what the deity Śāntaguṇa has realized.
Sentient beings are shrouded by ignorance and obstruction; Blind and dark, they dwell perpetually within birth and death.
The Tathāgata reveals the path of purity; this liberation of Sumerughoṣa is the unsurpassed path practiced by all Buddhas.
No sentient beings are able to fathom it, yet he reveals it through various doors of skillful means; one who observes with pure eyes can fully comprehend it.
The Tathāgata constantly uses the gates of dhāraṇī— Like the number of atoms in oceans of lands—to instruct and guide sentient beings everywhere. King Universal Radiance, one can enter this;
The appearance of a Tathāgata in the world is extremely difficult to encounter, Met but once in an ocean of immeasurable eons.
Able to cause sentient beings to give rise to faith and understanding—this is what the Sovereign Deva has attained.
The Buddha teaches that the nature of phenomena is entirely without intrinsic nature;
profound, vast, and inconceivable, he causes all beings everywhere to give rise to pure faith. The King of the Radiant Flame Devas is able to understand this well.
The Tathāgatas of the three periods of time are full of merit; their transformation of the realms of sentient beings is inconceivable.
To contemplate this gives rise to joy; thus one who delights in the Dharma can expound it.
Sentient beings are submerged in the ocean of afflictions; the turbidity of ignorance and views is truly terrifying.
The Great Master, out of compassion, causes them to be forever freed from this realm perceived by King Transformation-Canopy;
the Tathāgata constantly emits great rays of light, and within each ray,
immeasurable Buddhas each manifest deeds for transforming sentient beings— this is the gate entered by the Deva Sublime Sound.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Light of Delightful Radiance attained the liberation door of "constantly experiencing tranquil bliss while manifesting to extinguish the sufferings of the world.
The Celestial King Pure and Sublime Light attained the liberation door of "the ocean corresponding to a heart of great compassion, the treasury of joy and happiness for all sentient beings.
The Celestial King Sovereign Sound attained [the liberation door of] "pervading in a single thought-moment..."
The Celestial King Supreme Mindfulness and Wisdom attained the liberation door of manifesting the power of the merit of all sentient beings throughout boundless eons;
the Celestial King Pure and Wondrous Sound Delightful to Hear attained the liberation door of causing all worlds in their formation, abiding, and destruction to be entirely pure like space;
and the Celestial King Delightful Faith and Acceptance of All Sages’ Teachings attained the liberation door of loving, delighting in, and faithfully accepting the Dharma of all sages.
The Heavenly King Sound of Skillful Contemplation attained the liberation door of being able to dwell for aeons expounding the meaning of all stages (*bhūmi*) and their skillful means.

The Heavenly King Sound of Adorned Eloquence attained the liberation door of the skillful means for making great offerings whenever all Bodhisattvas descend from the Tuṣita Heaven to take birth below. The Heavenly King Profound Light-Sound attained [the liberation door of] contemplation...
The Celestial King Vast Renown attained the liberation door of the ocean of inexhaustible supernatural powers and wisdom;
the Celestial King Supreme Pure Light attained the liberation door of the power of skillful means for manifesting in the world with the fulfillment of the ocean of merits of all Buddhas;
and the Celestial King Deep Faith and Affection Treasury attained the liberation door of generating profound faith and joy through the power of the Tathāgata’s past vows.
At that time, the Celestial King Lovely Light (Priya-darśana-prabhāsa), empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the assemblies of the Gods of Limited Light (Parīttābhāḥ),
the Gods of Immeasurable Light (Apramāṇābhāḥ), and the Gods of Ultimate Light (Ābhāsvarāḥ), and spoke in verse:
I recall the deeds performed by the Tathāgata in the past, as he served and made offerings to boundless Buddhas;
through his original faith and pure karma, I now see them all through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power.
The Buddha’s body is formless and free from all defilements, eternally abiding in the ground of compassion and pity.
All worldly sorrows and afflictions are made to cease; this is the liberation of Sublime Light.
The Buddha-dharma is vast and boundless, appearing within it all oceans of lands, each with its own distinct manner of formation and destruction;
such is the power of the liberation of the Celestial King Sovereign Sound.
The Buddha’s power of spiritual transformations is peerless; he universally manifests throughout the vast lands of the ten directions, causing them all to be purified and ever-present before him.
Through the skillful means of supreme mindfulness and liberation, as numerous as the atoms within oceans of lands, he is reverently honored by all Tathāgatas.
Hearing the Dharma and becoming free from defilement is not in vain; this is the function of the Dharma-door of the Deva Sublime Sound.
The Buddha, throughout an ocean of immeasurable great eons, has taught the skillful means of the stages (bhūmis) without peer;
what he has spoken is boundless and inexhaustible—such is the meaning for the Deva Well-Considered Sound.
The Tathāgata’s gateways of spiritual transformations are immeasurable; in a single thought-moment, he manifests them in all places.

His great skillful means for descending from heaven and attaining enlightenment—this liberation of Adorned Sound can expound through the power it sustains, as well as manifesting the miraculous feats of all Buddhas.
Purifying all according to their faculties and desires—this is the liberation door of the Light-Sound Heaven.

The wisdom of the Tathāgata is boundless; peerless in the world and unattached, his compassionate mind appears universally before all beings according to their needs. The deity of Vast Renown has awakened to this path.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the practices for awakening, making offerings to all Buddhas throughout the ten directions;
at each and every Buddha’s place, he gave rise to a vow-mind. Upon hearing this, Suvarṇaprabhāsa was filled with great joy.
Furthermore, the Brahma King Śikhin attained universal abiding within the sites of enlightenment throughout the ten directions, preaching the Dharma, and his conduct was pure.
The Brahma King Wisdom Light of Purity and Non-attachment attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to enter dhyāna-samādhi and abide therein;
the Brahma King Good Thought Wisdom Radiance attained the liberation door of universally entering all inconceivable dharmas;
the Brahma King Universal Cloud Sound attained the liberation door of entering the ocean of all the Buddhas' voices.

The Brahma King Gate-Contemplating the Sovereignty of Words and Sounds attained the liberation door of being able to recollect the skillful means by which Bodhisattvas transform and teach all sentient beings.
The Brahma King Eye of Tranquil Radiance attained the liberation door of manifesting the distinct characteristics of the karmic retributions of all worlds.
The Brahma King Universal Radiance attained [the liberation door] that accords with the categories of all sentient beings.
The Brahma King *Sarvaprakārabhedapratyakṣavineyavimokṣa-nirmāṇasvara* attained the liberation door of dwelling in the realm of the practice of tranquility and the pure marks of all phenomena;

the Brahma King *Prabhāsacakṣus* attained the liberation door of constantly and diligently manifesting without attachment to any existence, being boundless, and having no dependence; [and the Brahma King] *Manojña*.
The Brahma King Ocean-Sound attained the liberation door of constantly contemplating and observing the inexhaustible Dharma.
At that time, the Great Brahma King Śikhin, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the assemblies of the Brahmakāyika,
Brahmapurohita, Brahmapārṣadya, and Mahābrahmā devas, and spoke in verse:
The Buddha’s body is pure and eternally quiescent; Its radiance shines throughout the world.
Without marks, without activity, and without reflection, Like the sky or clouds, thus is the Buddha’s body seen.
Such is the realm of meditative concentration; No sentient beings are able to fathom it.

He reveals to them inconceivable gates of skillful means—this ocean of dharma-gates, as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, which this King of Wisdom Light has realized. To expound them in a single word leaves nothing remaining;
even throughout oceans of eons, such an exposition would never be exhausted. This is the liberation of Well-Considered Wisdom Light.
The perfect voices of all Buddhas are equal to the world; Sentient beings each attain understanding according to their kind, Yet within those sounds there is no discrimination.
The Universal Sound Brahmā thus realized All Tathāgatas of the three periods of time Entering the skillful practices for awakening.
All things appear within the Buddha’s body; The liberation of the Sovereign Sound Heaven is the differentiation of the karma of all sentient beings.
According to their causes and conditions, the world manifests in various ways;
The Heaven of Tranquil Light is able to awaken to and enter this.
Mastery over all immeasurable Dharma-gates, Taming sentient beings throughout the ten directions, Yet never giving rise to discrimination therein— This is the realm of Samantaprabha.
The Buddha-body is like space, inexhaustible; Formless and unimpeded, it pervades the ten directions.
All manifestations are like transformations; The King of Transformed Sounds realized this path.
The physical marks of the Tathāgata’s body are boundless, And his wisdom and voice are likewise so.
Appearing in form within the world without attachment— The Celestial King Radiant Light enters this gate.
The Dharma King dwells securely in the palace of the sublime Dharma; the radiance of his Dharma-body shines everywhere without exception.
The nature of phenomena is peerless and devoid of all marks—this is the liberation of King Ocean-Sound.
Furthermore, the Heavenly King Sovereign obtained the liberation of the sovereign treasury that brings immeasurable sentient beings to maturity before one's very eyes.
The Celestial King Suvilocana attained the liberation door of observing the happiness of all sentient beings and causing them to enter the bliss of the noble realm.
The Celestial King Ratnaketu-makuṭa attained the liberation door of causing various inclinations and understandings of sentient beings to give rise to practice according to their respective desires.
The Celestial King Vīramati attained the liberation door of universally encompassing and explaining the meaning for all sentient beings.
The Celestial King Wondrous Sound of the Gate of Liberation attained the gate of liberation for increasing one’s own practice through mindfulness of the Tathāgata’s vast compassion;
the Celestial King Banner of Sublime Light attained the gate of liberation for manifesting the gate of great compassion that crushes and destroys all banners of pride;
and the Celestial King Realm of Tranquility attained the gate of liberation for subduing all malicious and harmful minds in the world.
The Celestial King Adorned Banner of the Wondrous Wheel of the Gate of Liberation attained the liberation door of all Buddhas of the ten directions coming to his presence whenever he recollects them;
the Celestial King Flower-Light Wisdom attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the attainment of perfect enlightenment according to the mental inclinations of sentient beings;
and the Celestial King Indra’s Wondrous Light attained the great majesty of universally entering all worlds.
At that time, the Celestial King Sovereign Power, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority,
surveyed all the hosts of the Heaven of Sovereign Power and spoke in verse:
The Buddha’s body is all-pervasive, equal to the Dharma-realm; Universally responding to sentient beings, he appears before them all.
Through various gates of teaching, he constantly transforms and guides; Mastery over the Dharma, he is able to bring awakening.
Of all the various pleasures found in the world, The noble joy of cessation is the most supreme.
Abiding within the vast nature of phenomena, the Celestial King Subtle Eye beholds this Tathāgata appearing throughout the ten directions,
preaching the Dharma in universal response to the minds of all beings and severing all doubts;
this is the liberation door of the Wondrous Banner Crown.
The Buddhas throughout the world proclaim sublime sounds;
The Dharma they have taught over immeasurable eons can all be fully expressed in a single word.
The liberation of the courageous Wisdom Deity and the vast compassion found in the world Do not equal even a single hair’s breadth of the Tathāgata.
The Buddha’s compassion is like space, inexhaustible; This is what the god Subhāṣitaghoṣa has attained.
The high mountains of pride in all sentient beings— The Ten Powers crush them entirely without remainder.
This is the application of the Tathāgata’s great compassion, The path traversed by the King of the Banner of Wondrous Light.
The light of wisdom is pure and fills the world; whoever beholds it is cleared of the darkness of delusion and led far away from all evil paths.
The Celestial King Śānta, having realized this Dharma, proclaims through the radiance of his pores the names of Buddhas as numerous as all sentient beings.
According to their inclinations, all hear it; This liberation of the Wondrous Wheel Banner is the sovereign power of the Tathāgata, immeasurable.
It fills the entire Dharma-realm and empty space, and all assemblies clearly behold it;
Into this gate of liberation, Flower Wisdom has entered.
Throughout oceans of immeasurable and boundless great eons, you appear universally throughout the ten directions to preach the Dharma;
never have I seen the Buddha come or go—this is what the Celestial King Sublime Light has realized.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Skillful Transformation attained the liberation door of "The Tranquil Power of Manifesting All Karmic Transformations."
The Celestial King Radiance of Sound attained the liberation door of relinquishing all objective attachments;

the Celestial King Light of Transformative Power attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the darkness of ignorance in the minds of all sentient beings and causing their wisdom to be perfected;
the Celestial King Lord of Adornment attained the liberation door of manifesting boundless and pleasing sounds; and the Celestial King Radiance of Mindfulness...
The Celestial King Cloud-Sound of Supreme Excellence attained the liberation door of knowing the inexhaustible marks of merit of all Buddhas;
the Celestial King Victorious Light attained the liberation door of universally knowing the sequence of the formation and destruction of all past kalpas;
the Celestial King Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of awakening the wisdom of all sentient beings; and [the Celestial King] Swiftly Filling the Ten Directions with Radiance...
The Celestial King Joyful Wisdom attained the liberation door of the indestructible power of diligence in all undertakings throughout the realm of empty space;
the Celestial King Flower Light Topknot attained the liberation door of knowing the karmic retributions received by all sentient beings;
and the Celestial King Universally Beholding the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of manifesting the inconceivable varieties of forms and species among sentient beings.
At that time, the Celestial King Skillful Transformation, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of the Heaven of Skillful Transformation and spoke in verse:
“The nature of karma in the world is inconceivable; The Buddha has revealed it all for the sake of the deluded masses.”

Skillfully expounding the true principle of causes and conditions, Observing the various karmas of all sentient beings, one finds the Buddha to be non-existent; Seeking throughout the ten directions, he cannot be found.
The Dharma-body manifests without reality— This is what the one of Silent Dharma-Sound has perceived.
The Buddha cultivated all practices throughout oceans of kalpas To extinguish the delusions and darkness of ignorance in the world;
Therefore, he is pure and most brilliantly illuminating. This is the light of power realized by the mind;
Among all the wondrous sounds in the world, None can equal the voice of the Tathāgata.
The Buddha, with a single voice, pervades the ten directions; Entering this liberation, he is the sovereign who adorns the world.
All the power of the merit of all beings in the world Is not equal to even a single mark of the Tathāgata.
The merit of the Tathāgata is equal to empty space— This is what the deva Citta-prabhā perceives.

All the immeasurable eons of the three periods of time, With all their various signs of formation and destruction, The Buddha can manifest within a single pore; This is what the Supreme Cloud-Sound understands.
The space of the ten directions may be measured, But the measure of a pore of the Buddha cannot be found.
Thus, the Celestial King Sublime Topknot, who has already awakened to this unimpeded and inconceivable state,
has throughout immeasurable kalpas of past ages fully cultivated the vast pāramitās;
through tireless and diligent application of effort, his joyful wisdom is able to understand this Dharma-gate.
The causal conditions of the nature of karma are inconceivable;
the Buddha has expounded for the sake of the world that the nature of phenomena is fundamentally pure and free from all defilements. This is the point of entry of Flower-Light;
you should observe a single pore of the Buddha, wherein all sentient beings are fully contained.
"He neither comes nor goes"—this is what King Universal Vision has realized.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Contented with Sufficiency attained the liberation door of the perfect wheel of teachings on the appearance of all Buddhas in the world;
the Celestial King Joyful Ocean Topknot attained the liberation door of the pure radiant body that exhausts the realm of empty space; and the Celestial King Most... [attained... the liberation door."
The Celestial King Banner of Supreme Merit attained the liberation door of the pure ocean of vows that extinguishes the sufferings of the world;

the Celestial King Tranquil Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting bodies to preach the Dharma; the Celestial King Auspicious Eyes attained the liberation door of universally purifying the realms of all sentient beings;
and the Celestial King Jewel Peak Moon attained the liberation door of universally transforming the world so that it is always present before one.
The Celestial King Endowed with Courageous Strength attained the liberation door of the inexhaustible treasury;
the Celestial King of Sublime Vajra Light attained the liberation door of firmly establishing the bodhicitta of all sentient beings so that it may never be destroyed;
and the Celestial King Constellation Banner attained the liberation door of personally attending to the appearance of all Buddhas.
The Celestial King Sublime Adornment attained the liberation door of skillful means for taming sentient beings through close observation;
the Celestial King Responding to Capacities attained the liberation door of manifesting in accordance with the faculties of sentient beings while knowing their minds in a single thought-moment.
At that time, the Celestial King Contentment, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the celestial hosts of the Heaven of Contentment and spoke these verses:
The Tathāgata is vast and pervades the entire Dharma-realm; He is perfectly equal toward all sentient beings.
Universally responding to the inclinations of the multitudes, he reveals the wondrous gateways, Causing them to enter the inconceivable, pure Dharma.
The Buddha-body appears everywhere throughout the ten directions; It is unattached, unobstructed, and cannot be grasped.
All the world beholds these various forms and images; this is the entryway of the goddess Priyamukhā.
In the past, the Tathāgata cultivated all practices, and his pure great vows were as deep as the ocean;
he caused all Buddha-dharmas to be fulfilled—only one of supreme virtue can know this skillful means.
The Dharma-body of the Tathāgata is inconceivable; like a shadow manifesting various forms, it elucidates all phenomena throughout the entire Dharma-realm.
Sentient beings are shrouded and obscured by the delusions of their own karma; their minds are scattered and agitated by pride and negligence.
The Tathāgata has taught the Dharma of tranquility; With his excellent eyes, he illuminates the mind and brings joy to all.
The true guide of all worlds appears as a savior and a refuge, Universally showing sentient beings the place of peace and bliss; Culinary Moon is able to penetrate deeply into this.
The realm of all Buddhas is inconceivable; it pervades and enters throughout the entire dharma-realm.
Having reached the further shore of all phenomena, those of courageous wisdom behold this and give rise to joy.
If there are sentient beings capable of being transformed, hearing of the Buddha’s merits, they shall proceed toward Bodhi.
Causing them to abide in the ocean of merit, ever pure;

The One of Sublime Light is able here to observe the oceans of lands in the ten directions, as numerous as atoms— He goes to and gathers at all the abodes of the Buddhas, Where he reverently makes offerings and listens to the Dharma; This is what is seen by the Banner of Adornment.
The ocean of the minds of sentient beings is inconceivable— Without abiding, without movement, and without a place of reliance;
The Buddha perceives it all clearly in a single thought-moment, And the Deva of Sublime Adornment understands this well.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Sovereign of Time has attained the power to initiate the roots of goodness in all sentient beings, causing them to be forever free from sorrow and affliction.
The Celestial King Subtle Light of the Gate of Liberation attained the liberation door of universally entering all realms;
the Celestial King Banner of Inexhaustible Wisdom and Merit attained the liberation door of the great compassion wheel that eradicates all afflictions;

the Celestial King Skillful Transformation and Majestic Adornment attained the liberation door of thoroughly knowing the minds of all sentient beings throughout the three periods of time; [and] the Celestial King Great Radiance of Dharani.
The Celestial King Mingtian attained the liberation door of the light of the *dhāraṇī* gate that remembers and maintains all dharmas without forgetfulness;
the Celestial King Bùsīyìhuì attained the liberation door of inconceivable skillful means for skillfully entering the self-nature of all karma;
and the Celestial King Lúnzhī attained the liberation door of skillful means for turning the wheel of Dharma to bring sentient beings to fulfillment.
The Celestial King Radiant Flame attained the liberation door of obtaining vast eyes to universally observe all sentient beings and go forth to discipline and liberate them;
the Celestial King Light-Illumination attained the liberation door of transcending all karmic obstructions and not following the deeds of Māra;

the Celestial King Universal Observer of Great Renown attained the liberation door of skillfully exhorting and instructing all the celestial hosts, causing them to accept and practice with pure minds.
At that time, the Deva King Seasonal Divisions (*Ṛtuprabha*), empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed all the hosts of the Seasonal Devas and spoke in verse:
“Over immeasurable and long-eon kalpas, the Buddha has already exhausted the ocean of worldly sorrow and affliction.”
He has extensively opened the pure path that is free from dust, Forever illuminating the lamp of wisdom for all sentient beings.
The Dharmakāya of the Tathāgata is exceedingly vast; Its boundaries cannot be found throughout the ten directions.
All skillful means are limitless; Only those with the wisdom of the Land of Wondrous Light can enter it.
Birth, old age, sickness, death, sorrow, grief, and suffering— These oppress the world without ceasing for even a moment.
The Great Teacher, out of compassion, vowed to eliminate them all; With the light of inexhaustible wisdom, he is able to awaken to them.
The Buddha’s illusory-like wisdom is unimpeded; He clearly penetrates all phenomena of the three periods of time.
Universally entering into the mental activities of all sentient beings—this is the realm of the Skillful Transformation Deva;
the limits of its dhāraṇī cannot be found. Its ocean of eloquence is likewise inexhaustible, and it can turn the pure and wondrous wheel of Dharma; this is the liberation of Great Light.
The nature of karma is vast and inexhaustible; with wisdom he has realized and skillfully revealed all inconceivable expedient means.
Thus, the Deva of Wisdom enters and turns the inconceivable, wondrous wheel of Dharma, manifesting the cultivation of the path to Bodhi.
Eternally extinguishing the suffering of all sentient beings—this is the ground of skillful means at the hub of the wheel.

The true body of the Tathāgata is fundamentally non-dual; yet, responding to things and assuming forms according to their needs, it fills the world, and each sentient being perceives it appearing before them. This is the realm of the Fire-Flame Heaven (Yama).
If there are sentient beings who behold the Buddha but once, he will surely cause them to purify and eliminate all karmic obstructions,
leaving no trace of the deeds of Māra remaining. Amidst the vast ocean-like assembly where the King of Light Tathāgata traverses his path, the Buddha shines with the most majestic brilliance.
Universally raining down the rain of Dharma to moisten all sentient beings—this is the liberation door named "Entry of Renown.

Furthermore, the celestial king Śakrendra attained the liberation door of "Great Joy through Clearly Seeing the Arising of Buddhas of the Three Times and Even the Formation and Destruction of All Lands," which enables him to remember them all. The celestial king Samantaghoṣa attained the [liberation door] that can cause...
The Dharma-door of the Buddha’s most pure and vast physical body, peerless in the world, was attained by the Celestial King Jewel-Crested with Compassionate Eyes;
the Dharma-door of the compassionate clouds universally covering all was attained by the Celestial King Renowned Banner of Jewel Light;
the Dharma-door of constantly seeing the Buddha manifesting various forms and majestic bodies before all world-protectors was attained by the Celestial King Producing Joy.
The Celestial King Joyful Topknot attained the liberation door of knowing from what meritorious karma the cities and palaces of all sentient beings arise;
the Celestial King Upright Mindfulness attained the liberation door of revealing the deeds of all Buddhas in maturing sentient beings;
the Celestial King Exalted Sound attained the liberation door of knowing the signs of transformation during the kalpas of formation and destruction of all worlds.
The Celestial King Accomplished Mindfulness attained the liberation door of recollecting the future practices of Bodhisattvas for taming sentient beings;
the Celestial King Pure Flower Radiance attained the liberation door of thoroughly knowing the causes of all celestial happiness;
and the Celestial King Wisdom Sun Eye attained the liberation door of revealing the roots of goodness for the rebirth of all sons of gods, ensuring they are free from delusion and confusion.
The Celestial King Light of Sovereignty in the Gates of Liberation attained the liberation door that awakens all the celestial hosts and causes them to forever sever various doubts.
At that time, the Celestial King Śakrendra, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed the entire assembly of the Trāyastriṃśa gods and spoke in verse:
I contemplate all Buddhas of the three periods of time; All their realms are entirely equal.
Just as their lands undergo destruction and formation, Through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, they are all seen.
The Buddha-body is vast, pervading the ten directions; Its wondrous form is peerless, surpassing all living beings.
Its radiant light shines everywhere without exception; this path is universally praised as that which can perceive the Tathāgata’s ocean of skillful means and great compassion.
Having practiced throughout past eons with ultimate purity, he guides and transforms sentient beings without limit; the Celestial King Ratnaśikhin has realized this.
I contemplate the ocean of merit of the Dharma King, Supreme in the world, without equal;
A vast heart of joy is thereby born. This liberation of the Deva Ratnaprabha— The Buddha knows the ocean of sentient beings' wholesome karma; Through various superior causes, great blessings arise.
He causes all to appear without exception; this is what the deity Joy-Crest perceives.
The Buddhas appear throughout the ten directions, pervading all worlds, observing the minds of sentient beings and manifesting their taming.
The Heavenly King Right Mindfulness has realized this path.
The Tathāgata’s wisdom-body is the vast eye that perceives everything down to the finest dust-motes of the worlds;
thus it pervades the ten directions. This liberation of the celestial being Jyotirghoṣa—the bodhisattva practices of all Buddha-sons—is manifested by the Tathāgata within every single pore.
Just as they are immeasurable and fully perfected, so does this King of Mindfulness clearly perceive all matters of peace and happiness in the world; all of these arise from the Buddha.
The Tathāgata’s merit is supreme and peerless; this is the Flower King’s entry into the state of liberation.
If one recollects even a small virtue of the Tathāgata, Or focuses the mind upon him for but a single thought-moment, the terrors of the evil realms will be forever eliminated.
With the eye of wisdom, one can deeply awaken to this within the Great Supernatural Power of the Dharma of Quiescence;
Universally responding to the minds of all beings, there is nowhere it does not reach.
All doubts are severed; this is the attainment of King Radiance.

Furthermore, the Son of Heaven named Pure Light attains the liberation door of universally illuminating the sentient beings of the ten directions throughout all future kalpas for their constant benefit.
The Son of Heaven named Flame-Eye attains the [liberation door] of awakening all beings through bodies that manifest according to their various types.
The Devaputra Sumeruprabha-ānandadhvaja attained the liberation door of causing beings to enter the ocean of wisdom;

the Devaputra Vimalaratnacandra attained the liberation door of cultivating all ascetic practices with a heart of profound joy; and the Devaputra Śūramgama-avaivartika attained the liberation door of acting as a master for all sentient beings to cause them to diligently cultivate boundless pure merits.
The Devaputra Wondrous Flower Garland Radiance attained the liberation door of obtaining unimpeded light that shines universally to benefit the spirits of all sentient beings.

The Devaputra Supreme Banner Radiance attained the liberation door of obtaining pure light that shines universally upon the bodies of sentient beings, causing them to give rise to joy and an ocean of faith and understanding.
The Devaputra Radiance attained the liberation door of obtaining light that shines universally throughout all worlds...
The Celestial Son Jewel-Crest Universal Radiance attained the liberation door of accomplishing various sublime merits;
the Celestial Son Eye of Radiance attained the liberation door of the ocean of great compassion manifesting various colored forms within boundless realms;
the Celestial Son Sustainer of Virtue attained the liberation door of purifying the eyes of all sentient beings so that they may see the treasury of the dharma-realm.
The Celestial Son Light of Universal Movement attained the liberation door of generating a pure, continuous mind that prevents its loss or destruction.

The Celestial Son Light of Universally Moving Solar Palaces attained the liberation door of universally moving the solar palaces to illuminate all sentient beings in the ten directions, causing them to accomplish their respective tasks.
At that time, the Sun Celestial Son, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed the entire assembly of Sun Celestial Sons.
And he spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata’s vast light of wisdom Shines universally upon all lands in the ten directions;
All sentient beings behold the Buddha, Through manifold skillful means of taming.

The Tathāgata’s physical marks are boundless; according to their inclinations, he manifests his body everywhere, universally opening the ocean of wisdom for the world. Flame-Eye, thus you should contemplate the Buddha:
the Buddha-body is peerless and beyond compare, its radiance shining throughout the ten directions.
Surpassing all, most unsurpassed—this Dharma gate was joyfully attained for the benefit of the world.

Having practiced asceticism through countless eons of coming and going within the realms of existence, his radiance is as pure and pervasive as space; the Jewel Moon is able to know this skillful means.
The Buddha proclaims wondrous sounds without obstruction, Pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
Benefiting all living beings with the flavor of the Dharma, He courageously understands these skillful means.
He emits inconceivable nets of light, Universally purifying all sentient beings.
Causing all to give rise to profound faith and understanding—this is the gateway of the celestial being Mālyadharī.
All the lights that exist in the world do not equal the light from a single pore of the Buddha;
such is the inconceivable radiance of the Buddha. This is the liberation of the Victorious Banner Light.
The Dharma of all Buddhas is thus: sitting beneath the king of bodhi trees, they cause those who follow non-ways to abide in the Way.
With the light of the Jewel-Crest, they see sentient beings suffering from blindness, darkness, and ignorance; the Buddha desires to cause them to give birth to the pure eye.
Therefore, he kindles the lamp of wisdom; The Lord of Sovereign Skillful Means, with virtuous eyes, observes this deeply.
If there are those who have once seen him and made an offering, He causes them all to practice until they reach the fruit. This is the power of the skillful means of the Virtuous Deity.
Within a single dharma-gate, there are immeasurable gates; Thus they have been expounded for immeasurable thousands of kalpas.
The vast meaning of the dharma-gates thus proclaimed Is fully realized by the Celestial King Universal Conveying Light.
Furthermore, the Moon Deva Prince attained the liberation gate of "Pure Light Universally Illuminating the Dharma Realm to Gather and Transform Sentient Beings."

The Celestial Son King of the Radiance of the Topknot attained the liberation door of observing all realms of sentient beings and causing them to universally enter the understanding of boundless dharmas.
The Celestial Son of Wondrous and Pure Light attained the liberation door of knowing the various objects of focus and the turning of the ocean of minds of all sentient beings.
The Celestial Son of the Mind that Brings Peace and Joy to the World attained [the liberation door] of being with all sentient beings...
The Bodhisattva King of Tree-King Eye-Light obtained the liberation door of causing beings to leap with great joy through inconceivable bliss;

the Bodhisattva King Pure Light Appearance obtained the liberation door of using compassion to rescue and protect all sentient beings, causing them to manifest the vision of those undergoing suffering.
The celestial son Samanta-gama-acala-raśmi attained the liberation door of universally roaming while remaining unmoved through the experience of joyful matters.
The celestial son Jyotiṣpati-vaśavartin attained the liberation door of revealing that all phenomena are like illusions, like space, signless, and without intrinsic nature.
The celestial son Viśuddhabodhi-candra attained [the liberation door] of acting universally for...
The Celestial Son Great Majestic Virtue Radiant Light attained the liberation door of initiating great karmic activities for all sentient beings;
at that time, the Moon Celestial Son, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power,
surveyed all the assemblies of devas within the moon palaces and spoke in verse:
The Buddha emits radiance that pervades the world, Illuminating all lands throughout the ten directions.
He expounds the inconceivable and vast Dharma, Permanently shattering the darkness of sentient beings' delusions.
His realm is boundless and inexhaustible; Throughout immeasurable eons, he constantly guides and instructs.
Manifesting various forms of mastery to transform all beings, The Flower-Tuft thus contemplates the Buddha:

The ocean of sentient beings' minds differs from moment to moment; The Buddha’s wisdom is vast and wide, knowing them all completely, And universally preaching the Dharma to bring them joy— This is the liberation of "Exquisite Radiance."
Sentient beings lack noble peace and happiness; Sunk in the evil realms, they undergo all manner of suffering.
The Tathāgata reveals to them the gateway of the dharma-nature; Through peaceful contemplation, they see it thus.
The Tathāgata possesses rare and great compassion; To benefit sentient beings, he enters into all states of existence.
He preaches the Dharma to exhort toward goodness and bring it to fulfillment; this is what the deity Sunetra understands.

The World-Honored One has opened wide the light of the Dharma, discerning the nature of all worldly karma—both good and evil—and how their practice is never lost or destroyed. Seeing this pure light, he gives rise to joy.
The Buddha is the support for all merit, like the great earth that sustains all palaces;
He skillfully reveals the path of peace and security free from sorrow. Unshakable, he knows this wisdom of skillful means;
the great brilliance of his wisdom-fire pervades the entire Dharma-realm, manifesting forms as numerous as sentient beings.
Universally opening the way to reality for all, The Celestial King Star-Constellation-King awakens to this path:

The Buddha is like space, devoid of intrinsic nature; For the benefit of sentient beings, he manifests in the world with marks and signs of adornment, like a reflected image. The Celestial King Pure-Awakening perceives it thus.
The pores of the Buddha’s body universally radiate sounds, And clouds of Dharma cover the world without exception;
All who hear them cannot fail to give rise to joy. Thus did the Deva Light of Liberation awaken to this.
*Commentary on the Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Fascicle Fourteen.

The Combined Commentary on the Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha’s New Flower Ornament, Scroll Fifteen.
The Sūtra translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda, a Śramaṇa from Khotan during the Tang Dynasty;
the Commentary composed by Li Tongxuan, a Layman of Fangshan in Taiyuan during the Tang Dynasty.
Compiled by the Śramaṇa Zhining of Kaiyuan Temple in Fuzhou during the Tang Dynasty, combining the sutras and commentaries.
Chapter One: The Sublime Adornment of the World-Ruling Sovereigns, Part Eight.
[Sutra] Furthermore, the Gandharva King Dhṛtarāṣṭra attained the liberation of skillful means for exercising sovereign mastery in gathering all sentient beings.
The Gandharva King Vimuktidvāravṛkṣaprabha attained the liberation door of universally manifesting all adornments of merit;
the Gandharva King Viśuddhanetra attained the liberation door of eternally severing the sorrow and suffering of all sentient beings and giving rise to the treasury of joy;
the Gandharva King Puṣpamakuṭa attained the liberation door of eternally severing the delusions of false views in all sentient beings.
The Gandharva King Joyful Gait of Universal Sound attained the liberation door of "extensively spreading like clouds to universally shade and moisten all sentient beings.

The Gandharva King Delightful Shaking Beautiful Eyes attained the liberation door of "manifesting a vast, wondrous, and excellent body to cause all to obtain peace and happiness. The Gandharva King Wondrous Sound Lion Banner attained...
The Gandharva King Universal Dispenser of All Greatly Renowned Jewels attained the liberation door of universally scattering all great renown jewels throughout the ten directions;
the Gandharva King Universal Radiator of Jewel Light attained the liberation door of manifesting a pure body of light that brings universal great joy;
and the Gandharva King Vajra Tree Flower Banner attained the liberation door of causing all trees to flourish everywhere so that all who see them are filled with joy.
The Gandharva King Universal Manifestation of Adornments attained the liberation door of skillfully entering the realm of all Buddhas to bestow peace and happiness upon sentient beings.
At that time, the Gandharva King Sustaining the Nation, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed the entire assembly of gandharvas and spoke in verse:
The realms of all Buddhas have immeasurable gateways, Which no sentient beings are able to enter.
The Sugata is pure like the nature of space, Universally opening the Right Path for the world.
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, The great ocean of merit is completely filled.
All worlds are brought to benefit and happiness; this King of Tree-Light is able to see it.
The vast ocean of sorrow and suffering in the world, the Buddha can exhaust and dry up entirely without remainder.
The Tathāgata’s compassion employs many skillful means; Pure Eye is able to understand this deeply.

The oceans of lands in the ten directions are boundless; The Buddha illuminates them all with the light of wisdom, Universally causing all evil and perverted views to be cleansed away. This is the gateway entered by the King of Flower Trees;
In the past, throughout immeasurable eons, The Buddha cultivated the practices of great compassion and skillful means.
All the worlds are brought peace and comfort; This path, Samantaghoṣa, you are able to awaken to and enter.

The Buddha-body is pure and all delight in beholding it; It can produce inexhaustible bliss for the world, And the sequence of cause and effect for liberation is accomplished. O One with Beautiful Eyes, you have skillfully revealed this here.
Sentient beings wander in confusion, Their ignorance and hindrances most firm and dense;
The Tathāgata expounds the vast Dharma, King Siṃhadhvaja, who can eloquently proclaim it.
The Tathāgata universally manifests a wondrous form-body, With infinite distinctions equal to all sentient beings.
Through various skillful means he illuminates the world, universally radiating precious light;
thus is the great wisdom of infinite gateways of skillful means perceived.
For the sake of all living beings, the Buddha universally expounds the true practice for entering supreme Bodhi; this is the excellent contemplation of Vajradhvaja.
In a single kṣaṇa, hundreds of thousands of kalpas— Through the power of the Buddha, he can manifest these without wavering.
Bestowing peace and happiness upon all living beings, This is the liberation adorned with bliss.
Furthermore, the Dragon Lord attained the liberation door of increasing the power to extinguish all enmity and harm, like a king of the kumbhāṇḍas.
The Kumbhāṇḍa King Adorned Banner attained the liberation door of cultivating the ocean-like gateways of boundless practices;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Beneficial Action attained the liberation door of knowing the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Terrifying attained the liberation door of universally accomplishing the activities of pure great radiance.
The Kumbhāṇḍa King Paṇḍaka attained the liberation door of revealing to all sentient beings the path of peace, security, and fearlessness;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Subhavyūha attained the liberation door of exhausting the ocean of craving and desire of all sentient beings;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Uccagāmin attained the liberation door of universally manifesting clouds of light throughout all realms of existence; and the Kumbhāṇḍa King Vīrabhuja...
The Kumbhāṇḍa King Pāṇḍaka attained the liberation door of universally emitting light to extinguish mountain-like heavy obstructions;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Ananta-viśuddha-netra attained the liberation door of revealing the treasury of great compassion that never regresses;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Viśāla-mukha attained the liberation door of universally manifesting bodies that flow through all realms of existence; at that time, the Kumbhāṇḍa King Vardhana...
The King of Kumbhāṇḍas, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of kumbhāṇḍas and spoke in verse:
"The World Teacher has perfected the power of patience; For the sake of sentient beings, he has practiced for immeasurable eons.
Forever free from the delusions of worldly pride, His body is therefore most majestic and pure."
In the past, the Buddha universally cultivated an ocean of all practices, Teaching and transforming immeasurable multitudes throughout the ten directions;
Through various skillful means, he benefited all living beings. This gate of liberation was attained by the Dragon King;
With great wisdom, he rescues sentient beings, There are none whose minds he does not clearly understand.
Subduing beings through various forms of mastery, The Adorned Banner beholds this and gives rise to joy.
His supernormal powers appear like reflections of light; The Dharma wheel is truly like space.
Thus he dwells in the world for immeasurable eons— This is what King Benefactor has realized.
Sentient beings are constantly deluded by the cataracts of ignorance; The Buddha’s light shines forth to reveal the path of peace and security, acting as their protector to eliminate suffering.

Those who can contemplate this Dharma-gate will see that those drifting in the ocean of desire, beset by manifold sufferings, Are universally illuminated by the light of wisdom, extinguishing them all without remainder.
Having already removed suffering, he preaches the Dharma; this is what the Wondrously Adorned has realized.
The Buddha-body universally responds, such that there is nowhere it is not seen. Through various skillful means, he transforms all living beings;
his voice thunders like a roll of thunder as he rains down the rain of Dharma. Such a Dharma gate is entered by High Wisdom.
Pure radiance does not arise in vain; when encountered, it surely causes heavy obscurations to dissolve.
Expounding the boundless merits of the Buddha, the Heroic Arm is able to clarify this profound principle;
desiring to bring peace and happiness to all sentient beings, he has cultivated great compassion for immeasurable eons.
Through various skillful means, he removes all suffering; such is the inconceivable mastery of supernatural powers seen by Viśuddhapuṣpa.
His body appears universally throughout the ten directions, yet within all things, there is neither coming nor going—this is what King Vipulavaktra has realized in his mind.
Furthermore, the Naga King Virūpākṣa attained the liberation door of extinguishing all the blazing sufferings of the naga realm;
the Naga King Sāgara attained the liberation door of transforming his own naga form in a single thought-moment to manifest in the bodies of immeasurable sentient beings;
and the Naga King Meghasvaradhvaja attained [the liberation door] of purifying all realms of existence...
The dragon king Pure Sound attained the liberation door of explaining the ocean of the Buddha’s boundless names;
the dragon king Flame Mouth attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the distinctions in the establishment of boundless Buddha-worlds;

the dragon king Flame attained the liberation door of causing the covers and entanglements of anger and ignorance in all sentient beings to be eliminated through the Tathāgata’s compassionate pity; and the dragon king Cloud Banner attained the [liberation door] of revealing and teaching...
The dragon king Mahānanda attained the liberation door of the ocean of merit of great joy for all sentient beings;
the dragon king Takṣaka attained the liberation door of the pure sound of protection that extinguishes all fears;

the dragon king Anantapada attained the liberation door of manifesting the physical bodies of all Buddhas and the sequence of dwelling through the kalpas; and the dragon king Viśuddhavarṇa attained the liberation door of rapid movement.
The Dragon King Birth of Great Love, Joy, and Delight in All Sentient Beings attained the liberation door of the ocean of great love and joy that gives birth to all sentient beings;
the Dragon King Universal Practice of Great Sound attained the liberation door of manifesting all equal, pleasing, and unobstructed sounds;
and the Dragon King Free from Heat and Affliction attained the liberation door of extinguishing all worldly suffering with clouds of universal compassion.
At that time, the Naga King Virūpākṣa, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of nāgas and spoke these verses:
"Behold, the Dharma of the Tathāgata is ever thus: It brings benefit to all sentient beings."
With the power of great wisdom and compassion, you rescue those who have fallen into the perilous paths;
though all sentient beings are diverse in their various forms, you manifest supernatural transformations upon the tip of a single hair, filling the entire world. Thus does Sāgara perceive the Buddha.
By the Buddha’s power of infinite supernormal faculties, he extensively proclaims his names, equal in number to all sentient beings;

according to their inclinations, they all hear and universally make offerings to him. Such cloud-like sounds can be understood by the multitudes in immeasurable and boundless lands, for the Buddha is able to cause them all to enter into a single pore.
The Tathāgata sits serenely within that assembly—this is what the dragon Jvālāmukha beholds.

The hearts of all sentient beings, bound by anger and shrouded by ignorance as deep as the ocean, The Tathāgata, out of compassion, utterly extinguishes; this the dragon Jvālāmukha is able to see clearly.
The power of the merit of all sentient beings is fully manifested within a single pore of the Buddha;
having been so manifested, they are led back to the great ocean of merit. This is what the High Cloud Banner contemplates:
from a pore of the Buddha’s body, rays of wisdom-light emanate, and those rays everywhere proclaim sublime sounds.
Sentient beings who hear this have their sorrows and fears dispelled; the dragon Takṣaka awakens to this path.

All Tathāgatas of the three periods of time, with the adornments of their lands and the succession of their kalpas, all appear thus within the Buddha’s body; Vipulakrama beholds these supernormal powers.
I observe the Tathāgata’s past conduct, in which he made offerings to an ocean of all Buddhas;
therein, he increased the hearts of joy and bliss for all. This is the entry of the Swift Dragon;
the Buddha, through skillful means and voices adapted to various types, preaches the Dharma for the sake of the assembly, causing them to rejoice.
His voice is pure and elegant, bringing joy to all; Hearing this everywhere, beings’ minds are gladdened and awakened.
Sentient beings are oppressed within the various realms of existence, Drifting through karma and delusions with no one to save them.
The Buddha, through great compassion, brings them liberation; Only the Great Naga Anavatapta can realize this.
Furthermore, the Yakṣa King Vaiśravaṇa attained the liberation door of rescuing and protecting evil sentient beings through boundless skillful means;
the Yakṣa King Sovereign Sound attained the liberation door of universally observing sentient beings and rescuing and protecting them through skillful means;
the Yakṣa King Adorned with Weapons attained the liberation door of being able to provide sustenance and benefit to all extremely weak and evil sentient beings.
The Yakṣa King Mahājñānavimokṣa attained the liberation door of extolling the ocean of all noble merits;
the Yakṣa King Jvālākṣa attained the liberation door of the great compassionate wisdom that universally observes all sentient beings;
and the Yakṣa King Vajranetra attained the liberation door of benefiting and bringing peace and happiness to all sentient beings through various skillful means.
The Yakṣa King Muktadvāravikrāntabāhu attained the liberation door of universally entering into the meaning of all dharmas;
the Yakṣa King Paravāraṇasenābhibhū attained the liberation door of protecting all sentient beings and causing them to abide in the Path so that none pass by in vain;
the Yakṣa King Vasu attained the [liberation door] of increasing the mass of merit for all sentient beings...

The Yakṣa King Destroyer of High Mountains attained the liberation door of the power of constant enjoyment of happiness and the light of wisdom born from the Buddha’s power through the force of recollecting in accordance with reality. At that time, the Great Yakṣa King Much-Hearing,
sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of yakṣas and spoke in verse:
Sentient beings, with their deep-seated evils, are truly terrifying;
drifting through birth and death for hundreds of thousands of eons, they fail to see a Buddha and undergo manifold sufferings.
To rescue such as these, the Buddha appears in the world; the Tathāgata protects all the worlds, manifesting himself before every single being.
It quiets the suffering of wandering on the perilous path; This Dharma gate, like the sound of a king, enters [the world].
For sentient beings whose evil karma constitutes a heavy obstacle, The Buddha reveals the wondrous principle to bring about understanding, Using clear evidence as an analogy to illuminate the world;
This majestic weapon of the Dharma can be perceived through contemplation.
In oceans of past kalpas, the Buddha cultivated all practices;
Because he praised all Buddhas of the ten directions, he possesses a lofty and far-reaching great renown. This King of Wisdom has realized it;
his wisdom is like space, without limit or bound, The Dharma-body is vast, expansive, and inconceivable.
Therefore, he manifests throughout the ten directions; with flaming eyes, he is able to observe all realms of existence.
He proclaims wondrous sounds, preaching the Dharma to benefit all sentient beings;
wherever his voice reaches, the manifold sufferings are extinguished. Entering this skillful means, he is the Vajra Eye.
The Tathāgata can expound in a single phrase all meanings that are profound and vast;
such teachings and principles pervade the world, realized by the King of Valiant Wisdom.
For all sentient beings dwelling on deviant paths, the Buddha reveals the inconceivable True Path.
Universally causing the world to become vessels of the Dharma, this valiant one who subdues armies is able to awaken to and understand all the meritorious deeds of the world;
all of these arise from the light of the Buddha’s radiance.
The ocean of the Buddha’s wisdom is difficult to fathom; such is the liberation of abundant wealth.
Recalling incalculable past kalpas, the Buddha cultivated the ten powers therein, enabling all those powers to reach full perfection; this is what King High Banner understands.
Furthermore, the Mahoraga King Good Wisdom employs all supernatural powers and skillful means to bring sentient beings [to maturity].
The Mahoraga King Pure Resonance attained the liberation door of accumulating merit;

the Mahoraga King Victorious Wisdom Adorned Topknot attained the liberation door of universally causing all sentient beings with wholesome or unwholesome thoughts and perceptions to enter the pure Dharma.
The Mahoraga King Subhāsanetrin attained the liberation door of the "Equal Sign of Sovereignty over Merit that Thoroughly Penetrates All Non-attachment";
the Mahoraga King Pradīpadhvaja attained the liberation door of "Revealing the Path for All Sentient Beings to Depart from Darkness and Fear";
and the Mahoraga King Varaprabhāketudhvaja attained [the liberation door of] "Supreme Radiant Banner."
The Mahoraga King Lion Chest attained the liberation door of generating joy by knowing all the virtues of the Buddhas;
the Mahoraga King Sound of Exquisite Adornments attained the liberation door of being a protector and savior for all sentient beings through the power of valor;
and [the Mahoraga King] attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to give rise to boundless joy according to their recollections.
The Mahoraga King Sumerumūrdhan attained the liberation door of reaching the perfection of immovability regarding all objects of focus;
the Mahoraga King Priyadarśanaprabha attained the liberation door of revealing the path of equality to all sentient beings who are unequal. At that time, the virtuous...
The Mahoraga King Prajñātejo’rcis, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of mahoragas and spoke in verse:
“Behold the nature of the Tathāgata, pure and stainless; He universally manifests majestic light to benefit all beings.”
He reveals the path of ambrosia to bring about coolness, so that all sufferings are forever extinguished and nothing remains to which one clings.

For all sentient beings dwelling in the ocean of existence, who are self-entangled and shrouded by evil karma and delusions, he reveals the dharma of tranquility they should practice; Vimalasvara is able to understand this perfectly.
The Buddha’s wisdom is peerless and inconceivable; He knows the minds of sentient beings without exception.
For their sake, he proclaims the pure Dharma; Thus, those with adorned topknots can awaken to this.
Innumerable Buddhas appear in the world, Universally acting as fields of merit for all sentient beings.
The ocean of merit is vast and deep, difficult to fathom; The Great King Subhūṣaṇa can see it all.

He perceives the sorrow, fear, and suffering of all sentient beings; The Buddha appears everywhere to rescue and protect them, Pervading the entire dharma-realm and empty space without exception— This is the sphere of activity of Dīpāṅkara.
The merits within a single pore of the Buddha— Though the world were to measure them together, they could not be fathomed;
Boundless and inexhaustible, like empty space, Thus does the Great Light Banner see the Tathāgata,
Who has mastered all dharmas And clearly illuminates their very nature.
Like Mount Sumeru, it is unshakable; Entering this Dharma-door, the Lion-Chested Buddha, In vast kalpas of the past, gathered an ocean of joy, deep and inexhaustible.
Therefore, none who see it fail to rejoice; This is the entry of Dharmavyūhaghoṣa.
Thoroughly knowing that the dharma-realm is formless, The ocean of pāramitās is entirely fulfilled;
With great light universally saving all sentient beings— Mountainside, you are able to know this skillful means.
Behold the Tathāgata’s power of mastery, Manifesting throughout the ten directions without partiality.
All sentient beings are universally illuminated and awakened; this wondrous radiance is able to enter [them] skillfully.

Furthermore, the Kinnara King Sunlight of Good Wisdom attained the liberation door of "Universally Producing All Joyful Deeds," and the Kinnara King Wondrous Flower Banner attained the [liberation door] of "Able to Produce Unsurpassed Dharma-Joy, Causing All to Receive It."
The Kinnara King Anala-vimokṣa-mukha-vicitra-alaṃkāra attained the liberation door of the vast and pure treasury of faith and resolve that fulfills all merits;

the Kinnara King Manojña-nāda attained the liberation door of constantly producing all pleasing sounds that cause those who hear them to be free from sorrow and fear; [and] the Kinnara King Ratna-vṛkṣa-prabhāsa...
King Nara attained the liberation door of establishing all sentient beings in great compassion so that they may awaken to their objects of focus;
King Universal Delight-to-See attained the liberation door of manifesting all sublime physical forms;
and King Supreme Light Adornment attained the realization of how all supreme adornments arise from their causes.
The Kinnara King Subtle Flower Banner attained the liberation door of skillfully observing the retributions born of all worldly karma.
The Kinnara King Power to Shake the Earth attained the liberation door of constantly initiating all deeds that benefit sentient beings.
The Kinnara King Fierce Lord attained [the liberation door] of skillfully knowing all kinnaras...

At that time, the Kinnara King Sunlight of Good Wisdom, through the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of Kinnaras and spoke in verse on the liberation door of skillfully governing the mind of Nara: The mind of Nara is skillful in governance and liberation; Now, by the Buddha’s majestic power, I shall explain it for you all.
