All the peaceful and blissful things that exist in the world arise entirely from seeing the Buddha;
The Teacher benefits all sentient beings, universally acting as a place of refuge and protection;
He gives birth to all forms of joy and happiness, so that the world may obtain them without end.
It ensures that those who behold it do not do so in vain; This is what the Flower Banner has realized:
the ocean of a Buddha’s merits is inexhaustible, and its limits cannot be found even if one seeks them.
Its radiance shines universally throughout the ten directions; this is the liberation of King Adornment.
The Tathāgata’s great voice constantly expounds and clarifies, Revealing the true Dharma that is free from sorrow;

All sentient beings who hear it are filled with joy. This lion’s roar can be believed and accepted, For I observe that the Tathāgata’s sovereign power Arises entirely from what was practiced in the past.
With great compassion, he saves all beings and brings them to purity; this king of jewel trees can be entered through realization.
Such a Tathāgata is difficult to encounter or even hear of;
after billions of eons, sentient beings may finally meet one whose various marks are fully and perfectly adorned—this is what King Sudarśana beholds.
Behold the Tathāgata’s great wisdom, which universally accords with the desires of the hearts of all sentient beings;

there is no path of omniscience that it does not proclaim. This most supreme adornment can fully comprehend the vast and inconceivable ocean of karma, from which arise the suffering and happiness of all living beings.
All these can be revealed by this King of Flower Banners,
who understands the uninterrupted spiritual powers of all Buddhas; the great earth in the ten directions constantly trembles,
yet no sentient beings are able to know it— this one of vast power perceives it clearly at all times.
Abiding within the assembly, he manifests supernatural powers, emitting great radiance to awaken beings and reveal the realm of all Tathāgatas;
this Sovereign of Fierce Power is able to observe all.
Furthermore, the Great Swift-Force Garuḍa King has attained an unattached and unobstructed eye, surveying the entire assembly.
The Garuḍa King Indestructible Jewel Topknot attained the liberation door of universally abiding in the realm of phenomena to teach and transform sentient beings;
the Garuḍa King Pure and Swift attained the liberation door of the power of diligence in universally accomplishing the pāramitās;
and the Garuḍa King Adorned with the Non-retrogressive Mind attained the liberation door of valor.
The Garuḍa King Power-Entry-into-the-Tathāgata-Sphere-Liberation-Door-Ocean-Abode-Upholding-Power attained the liberation door of entering the vast ocean of wisdom of the Buddha’s conduct;
the Garuḍa King Firm-Dharma-Pure-Light attained the liberation door of accomplishing the wisdom that distinguishes infinite sentient beings; and the Garuḍa King Wondrously-Adorned-Crown-and-Hair.
The Garuḍa King Universal Swift Manifestation attained the liberation door of adorning the city of the Buddha-dharma;
the Garuḍa King Universal Observer of the Ocean attained the liberation door of accomplishing indestructible impartial power;
and the Garuḍa King Dragon-Sound Great Eye attained the liberation door of manifesting forms while knowing the bodies of all sentient beings.
At that time, the Garuḍa King Great Swift Power, having attained the liberation door of the wisdom that universally enters into the knowledge of the deaths and births of all sentient beings,
and being sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of Garuḍas and spoke in verse:
The Buddha-eye is vast and boundless, universally manifesting throughout all lands of the ten directions;
the sentient beings therein are immeasurable, yet he manifests great supernormal powers to subdue them all.
The Buddha’s power of spiritual penetration is unimpeded, sitting everywhere beneath the Bodhi trees throughout the ten directions.
The manifestation of Dharma is like clouds that completely fill [the sky]; Baoji (Ratnaśikhin) hears this and his mind does not resist.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated all practices, Universally purifying the vast pāramitās;
He made offerings to all Tathāgatas— This King of Swift Speed possesses profound faith and understanding.
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, In a single thought-moment, infinite practices are universally manifested.
Such inconceivable realms of the Buddha— The adornments of non-retrogression are all clearly beheld.
The Buddha’s conduct is vast and inconceivable; No sentient beings are able to fathom it.
The Guide’s ocean of merit and wisdom, the sphere of activity of this King of Upholding,
the Tathāgata’s immeasurable light of wisdom, which can extinguish the net of sentient beings’ delusions and confusion—
this is the teaching upheld by Dṛḍhadharma, who protects all worlds.
The city of Dharma is vast and inexhaustible; its gates are manifold and beyond measure.

The Tathāgata, dwelling in the world, has extensively revealed it. This wondrous Crown-Hair (Makuṭa-keśa) can clearly enter into the single Dharmakāya of all Buddhas—true suchness, equal and without discrimination.
By this power, the Buddha dwells forever in peace; The King of Universal Swift Manifestation expounds this fully:

In all past existences, the Buddha gathered in sentient beings; He universally radiated light throughout the world, Using various skillful means to demonstrate their subduing. This supreme Dharma-gate was realized by Samudragarbha.
The Buddha observes that all lands abide entirely within the ocean of karma;
therein he universally rains down the rain of Dharma. Such is the power of the liberation known as Dragon Sound.
Furthermore, the Asura King Rāhu attained the liberation door of manifesting as the honored and sovereign lord of great assemblies.
The Asura King Mahāmati attained the liberation door of skillfully manifesting the illusory arts of immeasurable kalpas;
the Asura King Sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhin attained the liberation door of extinguishing all suffering of sentient beings and making them pure;
the Asura King Mahāparivāra attained the liberation door of self-adornment through the cultivation of all ascetic practices; [the Asura King] Vemacitra...
The Asura King Trembling Throughout the Boundless Realms of the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of "Universal Illumination";
the Asura King Universal Illumination attained the liberation door of "Establishing All Sentient Beings through Various Expedient Means";
the Asura King Firm Practice of Wondrous Adornment attained the liberation door of "Universally Gathering Indestructible Roots of Goodness to Purify All Defiled Attachments."
The Asura King Vast Cause Wisdom attained the liberation door of "Lord of Unwavering Resolve through the Power of Great Compassion.
The Asura King Manifesting Supreme Virtue attained the liberation door of "Causing All to Universally See the Buddha, Serving and Making Offerings, and Cultivating All Roots of Goodness.
The Asura King Fine Sound attained the liberation door of "Universally Entering All Realms with Determined and Equanimous Conduct."
At that time, Rāhu, the King of the Asuras, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power,
surveyed the entire assembly of asuras and spoke in verse:
"In all the vast assemblies throughout the ten directions, the Buddha is the most preeminent among them."
Its radiance shines everywhere, equal to space, appearing universally before all sentient beings;
throughout hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas and across all Buddha-lands, it is clearly manifested in a single kṣaṇa.
It extends its light to transform beings without exception—thus Vimalakīrti deeply praised and rejoiced.
The realm of the Tathāgata is without equal; through various Dharma gates, he constantly benefits sentient beings, causing all suffering to be extinguished. King Śambara is able to see this:
having cultivated ascetic practices throughout immeasurable kalpas, he benefits sentient beings and purifies the world.
By this, the Sage’s wisdom is universally perfected; The Great Retinue King beholds this Buddha’s unimpeded and peerless great supernormal powers.
He causes all lands throughout the ten directions to tremble, yet does not allow sentient beings to feel any alarm or fear; One of great power can clearly understand this.

The Buddha appears in the world to save sentient beings, revealing the path of omniscience in its entirety so that all may abandon suffering and attain peace and happiness. This meaning has been widely expounded by Samantaprabha;
through the power of the Buddha, he causes all oceans of merit in the world to be universally purified.
The Buddha can reveal the place of liberation; Through firm practice and adornment, one enters this gate.

The Great Compassionate Body of the Buddha is peerless; Moving everywhere without obstruction, it is seen by all, Appearing in the world like a reflected image; It is through wisdom that these merits can be proclaimed.
Rare and peerless are your great supernormal powers; You manifest your bodies everywhere, filling the entire Dharma-realm, Each sitting beneath a Bodhi tree.
One such as you, possessing this supreme virtue, can proclaim this meaning:
The Tathāgata’s past cultivation of practices throughout the three periods of time, Through which he has traversed every cycle of rebirth in all realms of existence.
"Having liberated sentient beings from suffering without exception—this is what King Wondrous Sound praises.
Furthermore, the Daytime Goddess Palace-Master manifested the liberation door of universally entering all worlds;
the Daytime Goddess Initiating Wisdom Fragrance attained the [liberation door] of universally observing all sentient beings to benefit them and cause them joy.

The day-spirit named Sovereign of the Splendid Adornments of the Joy of the Liberation Door of Fulfillment attained the liberation door of being able to emit the light of the Dharma that is infinitely lovely and delightful;
the day-spirit named Sovereign of Sublime Light of Flower Fragrance attained the liberation door of opening up the pure minds of faith and resolve of infinite sentient beings;
the day-spirit named Sovereign Who Universally Gathers Wondrous Medicines attained the [liberation door] of the accumulation of adornments.

The day-walking spirit Joyful-Eye-Lord, with the power of universal radiance, attained the liberation door of universally awakening all sentient beings in suffering and joy so that they may all obtain the bliss of the Dharma;
the day-walking spirit Universal-Manifestation-Lord of the Directions attained the liberation door of a body differentiated throughout the dharma-realm of the ten directions;
and the day-walking spirit Great-Compassion-Power-Lord attained the [liberation door] of rescue and protection.

The Daytime Spirit named Sovereign of Radiant Roots of Goodness Who Brings All Sentient Beings to Peaceful Liberation attained the liberation door of the power of merit that universally produces joy and contentment;
the Daytime Spirit named Sovereign of Exquisite Flower Garlands attained the liberation door of renown heard everywhere such that all who see her receive benefit;
at that time, the Daytime Spirit named Sovereign Who Manifests Palaces... [received empowerment].
By the Buddha’s majestic power, he surveyed the entire host of Day-Ruling Deities and spoke these verses:
"Buddha-wisdom is like space, inexhaustible; Its radiance shines throughout the ten directions.
It fully knows the mental activities of all sentient beings; There is nothing in all the worlds that it does not enter."
Knowing the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings, he preaches for them the ocean of Dharma according to their needs;
its phrases and meanings are vast and each distinct. The Spirit Endowed with Wisdom can perceive it all.
When the Buddha emits light that illuminates the world, those who see or hear it rejoice, and this is never in vain.
He reveals the profound, vast, and quiescent state; this joy adorns the mind as one awakens to the understanding that the Buddha rains down the Dharma in boundless measure.
It causes those who see it to experience great joy, and from this, the most supreme roots of goodness arise—thus was it awakened to by Sublime Light.

The power of universal entry into the Dharma-gates and the force of awakening—having cultivated and purified these throughout vast eons, they are all for the sake of gathering in sentient beings. This is what the Spirit of Various Medicines understands:
transforming the multitudes through various skillful means, so that all who see or hear them receive benefit.
Causing all to leap for joy and great rapture—thus does the Day-God Sublime Eye perceive the ten directions, manifesting throughout the world without exception.
The nature of the dharma-realm in the ten directions is neither non-existent nor existent; this is the entry of the God Who Contemplates the Directions.
Sentient beings wander through perilous hardships; The Tathāgata, out of compassion, appears in the world To cause all suffering to be utterly extinguished.

This gate of liberation abides in the power of compassion for sentient beings Who are shrouded in darkness and submerged in eternal night; The Buddha preaches the Dharma for them, opening great enlightenment.
Causing all to attain happiness and eliminate all suffering, the deity Mahāsubhaprabha enters this gate.
The merit of the Tathāgata is equal to space; all the various merits of the world arise from it.
Whatever is performed therein never goes to waste; thus one attains the liberation known as the Flower Garland.
Furthermore, the night goddess Samantaguṇaviśuddhaprabhā attained the liberation door of great heroic vigor through the joy of the bliss of tranquil meditative concentration;
the night goddess Priyadarśanā attained the liberation door of the marks of vast, pure, and delightful merit;
and the night goddess Lokapālajīvitāvastambhanī attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the world to discipline sentient beings.
The night goddess Silent Ocean Sound at the Gate attained the liberation door of the accumulated and vast mind of joy;
the night goddess Universal Manifestation of Auspiciousness attained the liberation door of profound, sovereign, and pleasing speech;
the night goddess Universal Emission of Tree Blossoms attained the liberation door of the treasury of great joy fulfilled by light; [and the night goddess] Equanimity...
The Night Goddess Paritrātrī attained the liberation door of awakening sentient beings and causing their roots of goodness to ripen;
the Night Goddess Sukhasaṃdarśanā attained the liberation door of infinite compassion that protects and rescues sentient beings;

the Night Goddess Nityapramuditendriyā attained the liberation door of the gate of great compassion manifesting universal adornments; and the Night Goddess Śuklapuṇyadarśanā... [attained the liberation door of] manifesting pure merit.
The liberation door of the goddess who universally causes all sentient beings to have their desires satisfied and attain liberation.
At that time, the night goddess Samantaguṇaviśuddhaprabhā, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of night goddesses and spoke in verse:
You all should contemplate the conduct of the Buddha: Vast, tranquil, and with the character of empty space;

The boundless ocean of desires he has entirely purified and cleansed. Stainless, dignified, and illuminating the ten directions, All worlds delight in beholding him; In an ocean of immeasurable eons, he is encountered but once.
Great compassion regards all beings without exception; This gate of liberation observes the world and beholds the Guide who protects all realms.
All sentient beings see him before them, Able to purify all states of existence; Thus does the Protector of the World observe.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the ocean of joy, Vast, boundless, and unfathomable;
Therefore, all who behold him rejoice. This is what the Silent Sound has realized:
The realm of the Tathāgata is immeasurable, Tranquil yet able to manifest throughout the ten directions.
Universally causing the minds of all beings to be pure, The goddess Śrī heard this and leaped for joy.

Among sentient beings who lack merit, The Buddha, with the majestic brilliance of great merit-adornment, Reveals to them the Dharma of detachment, tranquility, and cessation; The goddess Samantakusumaprabhā awakens to this path.

Universally manifesting great spiritual powers throughout the ten directions, He tames all sentient beings and causes them all to see his various forms and marks; This is what the Guardian and Nurturer Spirit beholds:
How, in every thought-moment of the Tathāgata’s past, He completely purified the ocean of skillful means, compassion, and kindness.
Saving and protecting the world, there is nowhere they do not pervade;
this deity of merit and bliss liberates sentient beings from the constant confusion and turbidity of ignorance.
Their minds are as firm and poisonous as they are fearsome, yet the Tathāgata, out of compassionate pity, has appeared in the world; this deity who extinguishes enmity is able to awaken to joy.
In the past, the Buddha practiced austerities for the sake of sentient beings, causing all their wishes and desires to be fulfilled;
thereby he perfected the marks of merit and virtue— this is the liberation door of Universal Manifestation Light,
attained by the Sovereign God of All Directions, Abiding Everywhere, who possesses the power of universal protection.
The World-Protecting Spirit of the Eastern Quarter attained the liberation door of the light-conduct adornment that accomplishes and transforms all sentient beings through spiritual powers;
the World-Protecting Spirit of the Southern Quarter attained the liberation door of the great radiance that destroys all dark obstructions and generates joy;

the World-Protecting Spirit of the Western Quarter attained the liberation door of universal manifestation in all places without fruitless toil; the World-Protecting Spirit of the Northern Quarter attained the [liberation door of] permanence...
The directional guardian deity Severing Delusion attained the liberation door of manifesting as many names as there are sentient beings to generate the merit of awakening.
The directional guardian deity Pervading Pure Space attained the liberation door of constantly emitting sublime sounds that cause all who hear them to rejoice.
The directional guardian deity Cloud Banner Great Sound attained [the liberation door] of causing sentient beings to be like dragons universally rained upon.

The Guardian of the Quarter named Joyful Liberation Crest-Eye Unconfused attained the liberation door of manifesting the sovereign power that is undifferentiated regarding the karma of all sentient beings.
The Guardian of the Quarter named Universal Surveyor of the World attained the liberation door of observing the various karmas within all realms of rebirth.
The Guardian of the Quarter named Pervasive Roamer attained the [liberation door] of what is performed...
The liberation door of bringing all matters to ultimate completion and giving rise to joy in all sentient beings.
At that time, the All-Pervading Lord of the Directions, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of lords of the directions and spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata, sovereign over the world, teaches and transforms all living beings,
universally revealing the Dharma gates so that they may awaken and enter them.
He causes them all to achieve supreme wisdom and immeasurable supernatural powers equal to those of sentient beings, manifesting various forms according to their inclinations.
All who behold it are granted liberation from suffering; this is the power of liberation of the deity Prabhāsa.
For the ocean of sentient beings shrouded in darkness, the Buddha manifests the great radiance of the lamp of Dharma;
its light shines everywhere, reaching all who see. This is the liberation adorned by such conduct.

Possessing all the various sounds of the world, he universally turns the wheel of Dharma such that no sentient beings who hear it fail to have their afflictions extinguished; this is what the deity Samantavyūha has realized.
All the names that exist throughout the entire world, including the name of the Buddha, arise as equal to them.
Causing all sentient beings to leave behind delusion and confusion—this is the sphere of activity of the one who has severed the deluded mind.

If there are sentient beings who come before the Buddha and hear the Tathāgata’s exquisite and wondrous voice, there are none whose hearts do not give rise to great joy; they travel everywhere through space and awaken to this Dharma.

In each and every instant, the Buddha universally rains down the boundless rain of the Great Dharma, causing the afflictions of all sentient beings to be extinguished; this is what the spirit Meghadhvaja understands.
Regarding the ocean of all karmas in every world, the Buddha reveals them all as being equal and without distinction.
Universally causing all sentient beings to eliminate karma and delusion—this is what the deity Keśinī understands.
The ground of omniscience is without limit; the Tathāgata perceives and clearly comprehends the various minds of all sentient beings.
This vast gateway is the contemplation of entering the world.
The Buddha, having cultivated all practices in the past, has fully perfected the immeasurable perfections;
with great compassion and pity, he benefits all sentient beings. This is the liberation of Vyāpaka-cārin.
Furthermore, the Ākāśa-deva named Viśuddha-prabhā-samanta-āvabhāsa attained the liberation of universally knowing the minds of all sentient beings in all realms of existence.
The space-dwelling spirit named Liberation of Universal Roaming in the Profound and Vast attained the liberation door of universally entering the dharma-realm;
the space-dwelling spirit named Producing Auspicious Winds attained the liberation door of the bodily marks that thoroughly penetrate boundless realms;

the space-dwelling spirit named Abiding Securely Free from Obstructions attained the liberation door of being able to eliminate the obstructions of karma and delusion for all sentient beings; and the space-dwelling spirit named Wide Steps and Wondrous Topknot...
The space-ruling spirit Lord of Universal Observation attained the liberation door of contemplating the vast ocean of practices;
the space-ruling spirit Lord of Unobstructed Radiance attained the liberation door of universally rescuing and protecting all sentient beings from calamities through the light of great compassion;
the space-ruling spirit Lord of Unobstructed Supreme Power attained the liberation door of universally entering all powers of merit that are free from attachment.
The space-ruling spirit Sovereign of Stainless Radiance attained the liberation door of enabling the minds of all sentient beings to be free from all hindrances and become pure;
the space-ruling spirit Sovereign of Profound and Wondrous Sounds attained the liberation door of the light of wisdom that universally perceives the ten directions;
the space-ruling spirit Light Pervading the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the world without moving from its original place.
At that time, the space-ruling spirit named Pure Light Shining Universally, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of space-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata’s vast eyes Are pure like empty space; They see all sentient beings everywhere.
All things are fully understood; the great radiance of the Buddha’s body Shines everywhere throughout the ten directions, appearing before all.
Universally wandering and observing this path, the Buddha’s body is like space— Unborn, without anything to be grasped, unattainable, and devoid of intrinsic nature. Thus was it seen by Śrīmati.

The Tathāgata, throughout immeasurable eons, Extensively expounded all the noble paths; Universal Extinction of Sentient Beings’ Obstructions (Samantavyūha) realized this gate, And through his radiant light.
I observe that in the past, The bodhisattva practices accumulated by the Buddha Were entirely for the sake of bringing peace to the world;
Wondrous Topknot (Sudarśanaśikhin) practiced this Dharma Throughout the realms of all sentient beings.
Wandering through the ocean of birth and death, the Buddha emits the light that extinguishes suffering.
The Unimpeded Power can see the treasury of pure merit; he is able to serve as a field of blessings for the world.
Following this, the Power of Awakening through Wisdom realizes herein that sentient beings, shrouded by ignorance, wander through perilous paths.
The Buddha emits a radiance that the stainless deity can witness;
His wisdom is boundless, manifesting all lands, And his light illuminates the world. With wondrous voice, he beholds the Buddhas;
The Buddha acts to deliver sentient beings, Cultivating practice throughout the ten directions— Such is the mind of great vows.
Furthermore, the wind spirit Universal Manifestation Capable of Observation attained the liberation door of universally entering the Buddha-dharma and all worlds;
the wind spirit Sovereign of Unobstructed Radiance attained the liberation door of the universal manifestation of the appearance of Buddhas in immeasurable lands, which is entirely vast.
The wind spirit named Cloud Banner Shaker attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing all illnesses of sentient beings with fragrant winds through making offerings;

the wind spirit named Pure Light Adornment attained the liberation door of universally generating the roots of goodness in all sentient beings and causing the mountains of heavy obstructions to be crushed and destroyed; and the wind spirit named Power Able to Dry Up Water attained the [liberation door] able to...
The wind spirit Great Roar Pervading All Directions attained the liberation door of destroying the boundless hosts of evil Māras;
the wind spirit Crested Locks Hanging from Tree Tops attained the liberation door of the ocean of eloquence that enters the true reality (*dharmatā*) of all phenomena;
and the wind spirit Unobstructed Universal Travel attained the [liberation door] of subduing all...
The wind spirit Sovereign of Various Palaces attained the liberation door of entering various gates of tranquil meditative concentration to extinguish the darkness of extremely heavy ignorance;

the wind spirit Sovereign of Great Light Shining Universally attained the liberation door of the unimpeded power that accords with the conduct of all sentient beings. At that time, the wind spirit Sovereign of Unobstructed Radiance...
Empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, the deity Universal Observer of All Wind Spirits surveyed the assembly and spoke in verse:
“The Dharma of all Buddhas is profoundly deep; Through unimpeded skillful means, they can universally enter it.
It constantly manifests throughout all worlds— Signless, formless, and without image.”
Observe how the Tathāgata, in the past, In a single thought-moment made offerings to boundless Buddhas;
Such courageous conduct for awakening— The spirit Viśvadarśin is able to realize it.
The inconceivable means by which the Tathāgata saves the world Leave nothing in vain.
Causing all sentient beings to leave behind every suffering— this is the liberation of the spirit Cloud Banner;
that those lacking merit undergo manifold sufferings, being constantly deluded and covered by heavy canopies and dense obstructions,
and causing them all to attain liberation— this is what the spirit Pure Light understands.
The Tathāgata’s vast and great supernormal powers Completely destroy all hosts of Māra;
All skillful means for subduing them, His courageous and majestic power can discern.
From a single pore, the Buddha emits wondrous sounds, And those sounds pervade the entire world.
All suffering and fear are caused to cease; this is what the deity Sarvanada understands.

Regarding how the Buddha, throughout inconceivable eons, constantly expounds this wondrous eloquence of the Tathāgata-ground across all oceans of world-systems, the deity Śikharacūḍa is able to awaken to and comprehend it.
The Buddha enters all gates of skillful means with wisdom that is entirely unimpeded;

his realm is boundless and without equal. This liberation of the Spirit of Universal Conduct is such that the realm of the Tathāgata has no limits, and through various skillful means, he causes it to be seen everywhere.
The body is tranquil and free from all marks; The various palace deities have gates of liberation.
The Tathāgata has cultivated all practices throughout oceans of eons, And has fully perfected all powers.
He can accord with worldly dharmas to respond to sentient beings— This is what the deity Universal Illumination perceives.
Furthermore, the Fire God Universal Radiance Flame Treasury attained the liberation door of completely eliminating all darkness in the world;
the Fire God Banner of Universally Assembled Light attained the liberation door of being able to pacify the suffering of the drifting heat and afflictions of the delusions of all sentient beings;
and the Fire God Great Light Pervasive Illumination attained the treasury of immovable merit-power and great compassion.
The Fire God Sovereign of the Palace of Myriad Sublime Gateways attained the liberation door of manifesting the boundless power of the Tathāgata’s spiritual penetrations;
the Fire God Sovereign of the Inexhaustible Light Topknot attained the liberation door of illuminating the boundless realm of empty space with light;
and the Fire God Sovereign of the Various Flame Eyes attained the tranquil light adorned with various merits.
The Fire God Palace-Lord of the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of being able to extinguish the blazing sufferings of all realms of existence in the world;
the Fire God Sovereign of Majestic Light attained the liberation door of freely awakening all worlds;
the Fire God Illuminating the Ten Directions attained the [liberation door] of forever shattering all...
The Fire-Ruling Spirit named Thunder-Voice-Lightning-Flash, who holds the liberation door of the foolish attachment to views,
attained the liberation door of the great thunderous roar that accomplishes all powers of aspiration. At that time, the Fire-Ruling Spirit named Universal Radiance Flame-Treasury,
empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of fire-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
Behold the power of the Tathāgata’s diligence, vast and inconceivable across billions of eons;
for the sake of benefiting sentient beings, he manifests in the world and causes all darkness and obstructions to be extinguished.
Sentient beings give rise to various views through ignorance, and their afflictions flow like rivers and blaze like fire.
The Guide’s skillful means completely eliminate [all obscurations]; The Universal Radiance Banner awakens to this here.
Merit is like space, without end; One cannot find its limit even by seeking it.
This Buddha’s great compassion is without effort; Like fire illuminating all, one awakens and enters with a joyful mind.
I observe the conduct of the Tathāgata, Which has passed through oceans of kalpas without limit;
Thus he manifests the power of supernatural transformations, Known by the deities of the myriad wondrous palaces.
Cultivated and perfected over inconceivable billions of kalpas, One cannot know its ultimate boundary even by seeking it.
Manifesting the true reality of the Dharma to bring joy, this is what the deity Infinite Light perceives.
All the vast assemblies throughout the ten directions gaze upon the Buddha before them;
his tranquil radiance illuminates the world—this is what the deity Subtle Flame can understand.
The Muni appears in all worlds, seated within every palace, universally raining down the boundless and vast Dharma. This is the realm of the deities of the ten directions;
the wisdom of the Buddhas is most profound, manifesting in the world with mastery over all phenomena.
Able to fully elucidate the true principle, With majestic light, he awakens to this and rejoices with a glad heart.
All views are shrouded by the darkness of folly; Sentient beings, deluded, constantly wander in saṃsāra.
The Buddha has opened and revealed the wondrous Dharma gate; This illuminating deity of the region is able to awaken and enter it.
The gateways of aspiration are vast and inconceivable; having purified the powers of diligence, all former vows now manifest. This is what the spirit Vajrasvara understands.
Furthermore, the water spirit Samantābhyudgata-megha-dhvaja attains the compassionate liberation that brings equal benefit to all sentient beings.
The water spirit Ocean Tide Cloud Sound Master of Liberation attained the liberation door of the wondrous color wheel topknot adorned with boundless dharmas;
the water spirit Skillful Whirlpool attained the liberation door of universally gathering those to be transformed through skillful means by observing them;
and the water spirit Stainless Fragrant Accumulation attained the liberation door of universally expounding the profound realms of all Buddhas.
The water-ruling spirit Universal Manifestation of Pure Great Radiance attained the liberation door of "Universal Manifestation of Pure Great Radiance.
The water-ruling spirit Light-Sound of the Auspicious Bridge attained the liberation door of "the signless and natureless pure dharma-realm.

The water-ruling spirit Sovereign of Contentment and Mastery attained the liberation door of "the inexhaustible ocean of great compassion. The water-ruling spirit Pure Joy and Virtuous Sound attained [the liberation door] regarding bodhisattvas...
Within the assembly at the site of enlightenment, the water spirit Sovereign of Universal Manifestation of Majestic Light attained the liberation door of the treasury of great joy;

the water spirit Sovereign of Roaring Sounds Pervading the Ocean attained the liberation door of observing all sentient beings and initiating skillful means of subduing them that are as vast as space.
At that time, the water-ruling spirit named Universal Cloud Banner Arising, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed the entire assembly of water-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
"Pure gates of compassion, as numerous as the atoms of a world-system, Together give rise to a single sublime mark of the Tathāgata."
Not one of these marks is otherwise; therefore, those who behold them can never be satiated.
When the World-Honored One practiced in the past, he went before all Tathāgatas and cultivated every kind of purification without weariness. Such is the Cloud-Sound Entrance through skillful means.
The Buddha, within all the ten directions, is tranquil and unmoving, neither coming nor going;
yet he causes all sentient beings to behold his manifestations. This is what the Cūḍāmaṇi knows:
the realm of the Tathāgata is boundless and immeasurable, such that no sentient beings can fully comprehend it.
The wondrous voice proclaims throughout the ten directions; this is the sphere of activity of the spirit Good Whirlpool.
The World-Honored One’s radiance is inexhaustible, pervading the inconceivable Dharma-realm;
he teaches the Dharma to transform and deliver sentient beings—this is what the spirit Pure Fragrance observes and beholds.
The Tathāgata is pure, equal to space; Formless and shapeless, he pervades the ten directions.
Yet he causes the entire assembly to see him; This is the god Puṇyaprabha’s skillful observation.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the gate of great compassion; His mind was vast and pervasive, equal to all sentient beings.
Therefore, like clouds appearing in the world, this gate of liberation fully knows all the lands throughout the ten directions; it sees the Tathāgatas seated upon their thrones,
clearly awakening to great Bodhi— such is the entry of Joyful Sound.
The Tathāgata’s conduct is free from all obstruction; He travels everywhere to all lands in the ten directions, manifesting great supernormal powers in each place.
Having universally manifested majestic light, he has been able to awaken to and cultivate boundless practices of skillful means; Equal to the realm of sentient beings, he completely fills it all.
The wondrous power of his supernormal faculties never ceases;
his roar pervades the ocean, enabling entry into this Great Vaipulya Buddha Avataṃsaka Sūtra. Combined Commentary, Volume Fifteen. Phonetic Transcriptions.
