Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda, a śramaṇa from the Kingdom of Khotan during the Tang Dynasty.
The Treatise composed by Li Tongxuan, Elder of Fangshan in Taiyuan of the Tang Dynasty;
the Sūtra text collated with the Treatise by the Śramaṇa Zhining of Kaiyuan Monastery in Fuzhou of the Tang Dynasty.
Chapter One: The Sublime Adornment of the World Rulers, Part Nine.

[Sūtra] Furthermore, the ocean-dwelling spirit named Jewel Light Manifestation attained the liberation door of adorning the body with the ocean-like multitude of jewels through the merit of bestowing gifts upon all sentient beings with an impartial mind;

the ocean-dwelling spirit named Indestructible Vajra Banner attained the liberation door of skillfully protecting the roots of goodness of all sentient beings; and the ocean-dwelling spirit named Untainted by Dust...
The Ocean-Ruling Spirit Cloud of Divine Power attained the liberation door of being able to exhaust the ocean of afflictions of all sentient beings;
the Ocean-Ruling Spirit Constantly Abiding in the Waves attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to leave the evil realms;

the Ocean-Ruling Spirit Auspicious Jewel Moon attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the darkness of great ignorance; the Ocean-Ruling Spirit Exquisite Flower Dragon Topknot attained the extinction of all... [text truncated]

The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of the Flavor of Universal Sustaining Light attained the liberation door of purifying the nature of all sentient beings' delusions regarding views concerning the suffering and happiness of the various realms of existence.

The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of Jewel Flame Flower Light attained the liberation door of giving birth to the bodhicitta of all jewel-lineages. The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of the Wondrous Topknot of Vajra attained...
The Ocean-Dwelling Spirit named Sound of the Tide and Thunder of Liberation, who possesses the liberation door of the ocean of merit of the immovable mind,
attained the liberation door of the samādhi gate of universal entry into the dharma-realm. At that time, the Ocean-Dwelling Spirit named Sovereign of the Appearance of Jewel Light,
empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of ocean-dwelling spirits and spoke in verse:
Throughout inconceivable oceans of great kalpas, He makes offerings to all Tathāgatas;
Universally bestowing his merit upon all living beings, He is therefore most peerless in his majesty and grace.
Appearing throughout all worlds, There is no faculty, inclination, or desire of sentient beings he does not know.
Universally proclaiming the great ocean of the Dharma—this is what the Firm Banner has joyfully realized.
Among all the teachers of the world, his rain from the clouds of Dharma is unfathomable;
it dries up the infinite oceans of suffering. This is how one free from defilement enters this gate.
All sentient beings are shrouded by afflictions, Cycling through the various realms and undergoing manifold sufferings;
For their sake, he reveals the realm of the Tathāgata— The Spirit of the Universal Water Palace enters this gate.
Throughout an inconceivable ocean of kalpas, The Buddha has practiced all deeds without end.
Forever severing the net of delusion and confusion for sentient beings, The Jewel Moon is able to clearly enter this;

Seeing that sentient beings are constantly terrified As they wander through the great ocean of birth and death, He reveals to them the unsurpassed path of the Tathāgata; Thus, Dragon Topknot attained awakening and gave rise to joy.
The realm of all Buddhas is inconceivable; The Dharma-realm and empty space share the mark of equality.
It can purify the net of sentient beings' ignorance and delusion; One who upholds and savors it can thus proclaim it.
The Buddha-eye is pure and inconceivable, Comprehending and encompassing all realms.
Universally revealing to all sentient beings the various wondrous paths—this is what the mind of Padmaprabha has realized.
Though the armies of Māra are vast and beyond counting, he utterly destroys them in a single kṣaṇa;
his mind is unshakable and unfathomable—such is the skillful means of Vajramaṇicūḍa.
Universally throughout the ten directions they proclaim wondrous sounds, And those sounds pervade the entire dharma-realm without exception.
This is the realm of the Tathāgata’s samādhi, The sphere of activity of the spirit Sea-Tide Sound.
Furthermore, the River-Spirit Lord of Universally Issuing Swift Currents attained the liberation door of "universally raining the boundless rain of Dharma. Universal...
The River Spirit Pure Spring Grotto attained the liberation door of manifesting before all sentient beings to cause them to forever leave behind afflictions and achieve liberation.
The River Spirit Dust-Free Pure Eye attained the liberation door of universally cleansing the dust and grime of all sentient beings' delusions through the skillful means of great compassion.
The River Spirit Ten Directions Universal Roar attained the liberation door of constantly producing benefit.
The River Goddess Universal Protector of Sentient Beings attained the liberation door of universally understanding the voices of all beings.
The River Goddess Sovereign of Heatless Pure Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting all roots of goodness that bring cooling relief.
The River Goddess Universal Producer of Joy attained the liberation door of practicing with... [perfection].
The river goddess Sovereign of the Foot of Generosity attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to forever leave behind stinginess and attachment;
the river goddess Sovereign of the Banner of Vast Virtue attained the liberation door of acting as a field of merit that brings joy to all;

the river goddess Sovereign of Radiant Illumination Throughout the World attained the liberation door of being able to purify those sentient beings who are defiled by impurities and to bring joy to those whose poison is anger; [the river goddess] Ocean... [attained the liberation door].
The River Goddess Virtue-Light Sovereign attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings to enter the ocean of liberation and constantly experience perfect bliss.
At that time, the River Goddess Universal Emission of Swift Currents, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed the entire assembly of river goddesses and spoke in verse:
In the past, for the sake of sentient beings, the Tathāgata cultivated boundless practices within the ocean of Dharma;
like a torrential rain that clears the scorching heat, he universally extinguished the fever of afflictions in all beings.
For immeasurable eons, it was difficult for the Buddha to proclaim these deeds, yet through the light of his vows, he purifies the world.
Those whose faculties are matured are led to awaken to the Way; this is what the spirit Pujeha has realized—great compassion and skillful means that equalize all sentient beings.
Appearing before them all, he constantly transforms and guides them, universally purifying the defilements of their afflictions. Seeing this with pure eyes, [the Buddha] feels deep joy.
The Buddha emits wondrous sounds, universally enabling all to hear; Sentient beings love and delight in them, their hearts filled with joy.
He causes all immeasurable sufferings to be cleansed away—this is the liberation of the deity Vyāghraraṭa.
In the past, when the Buddha practiced the conduct for awakening, For the sake of benefiting sentient beings, he did so for immeasurable eons.
Therefore, this light pervades the world; The guardian deity, mindful of it, gives rise to joy.
Having practiced past austerities for the sake of sentient beings, He employs various skillful means to bring them to maturity.
Universally purifying the ocean of merit and removing all suffering— Anatapa, seeing this, rejoices in his heart.
The gate of giving is vast and inexhaustible, Benefiting all sentient beings without exception;
It enables all who see it to be free from stinginess and attachment— This is what the spirit Sampraharṣaṇī has realized.
The Buddha practiced these true expedient means in the past, Thereby accomplishing a boundless ocean of merit.
All who behold her cannot help but rejoice; this goddess Victory Banner awakens the hearts of beings with joy.
She purifies all defilements and gives rise to loving-kindness toward all enemies and harms;
thus she attains a radiant light that fills the void, and the river goddesses of the entire world see her and are filled with delight.
The Buddha is a field of merit, an ocean of virtue, capable of causing all beings to leave behind every evil and even to achieve great Bodhi. This is the liberation of the deity Samudraprabha.
Furthermore, the deity Sasyasvādurasa, Lord of Crops, has attained the power to provide the flavor of the Dharma to all sentient beings, enabling them to reach fulfillment.

At the time of the Buddha’s teaching on the gate of liberation of the body, the field-protecting deity Flower-Pure-Light attained the gate of liberation that enables all sentient beings to experience vast joy and bliss;
the field-protecting deity Color-Strength-Vigorous attained the gate of liberation that purifies all realms through the dharma-gate of universal perfection;
and the field-protecting deity Increasing Vitality attained the gate of liberation of beholding the Buddha.
The Harvest Goddess Sovereign of Universal Roots and Fruits attained the liberation door of immeasurable great compassion, supernormal powers, transformations, and the force of mastery;
the Harvest Goddess Sovereign of the Universal Manifestation of the Buddha’s Field of Merit attained the liberation door of ensuring that seeds sown do not perish;

the Harvest Goddess Sovereign of the Wondrously Adorned Circular Topknot attained the liberation door of universally inspiring the flower of pure faith in all sentient beings; and the Harvest Goddess Sovereign of Moistening Pure Flowers attained—
The field-protecting deity Great Compassionate Savior of All Beings attained the liberation door of causing the ocean of merit and virtue to increase;
the field-protecting deity Master of Exquisite Fragrance attained the liberation door of extensively revealing all methods of practice;
and the field-protecting deity Beloved by All Who Behold attained the [liberation door] that enables all sentient beings throughout the dharma-realm to abandon indolence, sorrow, and all other evils.
The liberation door of the Crop-Master Spirit named Sovereign of Stainless Radiance,
who observes the roots of goodness of all sentient beings and teaches the Dharma according to their needs so that the assembly is filled with joy and satisfaction; at that time,
the Crop-Master Spirit named Sovereign of Soft and Exquisite Flavor, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire host of crop-masters and spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata’s unsurpassed ocean of merit universally manifests as a bright lamp illuminating the world;
he protects and delivers all sentient beings, bestowing peace and happiness upon every single one without exception.
The World-Honored One’s merit is boundless; those who hear it shall not do so in vain.
Causing all to leave suffering behind and always rejoice; This is the entry into the Sugata’s powers through the Flower of Time.
Adorned with merit, appearing in the world, All sentient beings are completely tamed; This Dharma-courage and power can clearly realize this.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the ocean of great compassion; His mind, in every thought-moment, was equal toward all in the world.
Therefore, his supernormal powers are boundless; He increases vital energy and can perceive the Buddha Pervading the world, ever manifest before him. None of his skillful means pass in vain.
He completely purifies all the delusions and afflictions of sentient beings; this is the liberation of the Spirit of Universal Birth.
This Buddha is a great ocean of wisdom in the world, emitting pure radiance that reaches everywhere;
from it, vast faith and understanding are entirely born. Thus does Adorned Topknot clearly enter [this state].
The Tathāgata, observing the world, gave rise to a heart of compassion;
for the benefit of sentient beings, he appeared and revealed to them the most supreme path of tranquility and joy.
This liberation of the deity Viśuddhapuṣpa, and the pure conduct practiced by the Sugata, were fully proclaimed beneath the Bodhi tree.
Thus they teach and transform throughout the ten directions; this goddess Subhagaśrī is able to hear and receive it.
In all worlds, the Buddha causes all beings to leave sorrow behind and give rise to great joy;
he heals and purifies all their faculties and desires—this goddess Priyaṃkara has realized and entered into this.

When the Tathāgata appears in the world, he universally observes the inclinations of the minds of sentient beings and brings them to maturity through various skillful means; this is the liberation door of the spirit Pure Light.
Furthermore, the medicinal spirit Auspicious Lord attained the liberation door of diligently gathering in all sentient beings by universally observing their minds.

The medicinal goddess Candanavana, who presides over the grove of sandalwood, attained the liberation door of gathering in sentient beings with radiant light so that those who see her do not pass by in vain.
The medicinal goddess Virajaprabhā attained the liberation door of being able to extinguish the afflictions of all sentient beings through pure skillful means.
The medicinal goddess Viśrutayaśas attained the [liberation door] of being able to [manifest] her great fame.
The medicinal goddess named Sovereign of Light-Emanating from a Pore attained the liberation door of increasing the boundless ocean of roots of goodness;
the medicinal goddess named Sovereign of Purifying Darkness attained the liberation door of swiftly reaching the realms of all illnesses with the banner of great compassion;
the medicinal goddess named Universally Uttering a Roar attained the liberation door of healing all sentient beings blinded by ignorance and purifying their eye of wisdom.
The medicinal deity Lord of Medicinal Herbs attained the liberation door of being able to expound the Buddha’s voice to explain the distinct meanings of all dharmas;

the medicinal deity Lord of the Banner that Obscures the Sunlight attained the liberation door of acting as a spiritual friend to all sentient beings so that all who see them give rise to roots of goodness;
the medicinal deity Clear Vision of the Ten Directions attained the pure treasury of great compassion, which is able to... [the text here is incomplete].

He then caused them to enter the liberation door of "Universally Emitting Majestic Radiance," whereby the Medicine King Spirit Attaining Skillful Means to Cause the Recollection of the Buddha to Extinguish All Sicknesses of Sentient Beings attained this liberation door. At that time, the Medicine King Spirit Auspiciousness,
empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of Medicine King Spirits and spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata’s wisdom is inconceivable; he fully knows the minds of all sentient beings.
Through various powers of skillful means, he extinguishes the immeasurable suffering of those deluded multitudes.
The Great Hero’s mastery is difficult to fathom; whatever he does never goes to waste.
They must cause the various sufferings of sentient beings to be extinguished; The sandalwood forest deity can realize this.

Observe how the Buddhas’ teachings are thus: In the past, they diligently practiced for immeasurable eons, Yet remained unattached to any state of existence. This is the gateway entered by the Radiance Free from Dust.
A Buddha is difficult to encounter even in hundreds of thousands of kalpas;
yet whoever beholds him or hears his name will surely obtain benefit, never in vain. This is what the deity Viśvānāman understands:
from every single pore of the Tathāgata, light rays are emitted to extinguish all afflictions.
All worldly afflictions are brought to exhaustion; this is the gateway entered by the deity Prabhāsa.
All sentient beings are blinded by ignorance, and their delusions, karma, and immeasurable sufferings are individually removed by the Buddha, who opens the illumination of wisdom.
Thus, having shattered the darkness, he is able to perceive clearly.

The single voice of the Tathāgata is immeasurable; It can open the ocean of all dharma-gates, and all sentient beings who hear it understand them completely. This is the liberation of the Great Sound.
Behold the Buddha’s wisdom, inconceivable, Universally appearing in all realms of existence to save all living beings.
They cause all who behold them to be transformed; this Banner that Obscures the Sun has deeply realized the ocean of the Tathāgata’s great compassion and skillful means.
Appearing for the benefit of the world, they extensively open the Right Path and show it to sentient beings; this Deity of Vision in the Quarter can thoroughly comprehend this.
The Tathāgata universally radiates great light, Which illuminates all the ten directions without exception;
Causing beings to give rise to merit by recollecting the Buddha— This is the liberation door of "Emanating Majestic Light.
Furthermore, the Forest-Ruling Spirit Flower-Cloud Array attained the liberation door of "The Vast and Boundless Treasury of the Ocean of Wisdom."
The forest spirit Udyotitaskandha attained the liberation door of vast cultivation and universal purification;
the forest spirit Aṅkurapraroharaśmi attained the liberation door of increasing the sprouts of various pure faiths;
the forest spirit Śrīpariśuddhapatra attained the liberation door of the collection of all pure meritorious adornments; [and] the forest spirit Jvālāntarāvabhāsa.
The forest-ruling spirit *Vairocanavyūhaprabha* attained the liberation door of the universal gate of pure wisdom that constantly surveys the entire dharma-realm;

the forest-ruling spirit *Sarvasattvacaryāsāgarajñānadharmameghasamudgata* attained the liberation door of universally knowing the ocean of practices of all sentient beings and spreading the clouds of Dharma;
the forest-ruling spirit *Manojñarutaghoṣa* attained the liberation door of enduring all unpleasant sounds and manifesting purity.

The forest spirit Sound-Liberation-Door-Pervasive-Fragrance-Radiance attained the liberation door of the realm of vast conduct cultivated in the past, which manifests universally throughout the ten directions;
the forest spirit Sublime-Light-Distant-Shining attained the liberation door of benefiting the world through all dharmas of merit;
the forest spirit Flower-Fruit-Radiant-Taste attained the power to enable a single...
The liberation door of "Always Reverently Remembering and Never Forgetting the Appearance of a Buddha and Adorning the Treasury of Merit" was seen by all. At that time,
the forest-ruling spirit named Cloud-like Flower-Spreader, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of forest-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the practices for awakening; his merit and wisdom were fully perfected, and he was endowed with all the powers.

He emitted great light that transcends the world, and his gateways of compassion are as immeasurable as sentient beings. Thus, in former times, the Tathāgata universally purified and refined them all.
Therefore, he is able to provide benefit and refuge to the world; this is what the spirit Netrodbhava understands.

If there are sentient beings who see the Buddha even once, he will surely cause them to enter the ocean of profound faith and universally reveal the path of all Tathāgatas; this is the liberation of the spirit Sūkṣmāṅkura.
The various merits gathered within a single hair could not be fully proclaimed even throughout oceans of eons;
the skillful means of all Buddhas are inconceivable, yet Pure Leaf can clarify this profound meaning.
I recall that in the past, the Tathāgata made offerings to infinite Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of all lands.
At each and every Buddha’s abode, their wisdom gradually brightens; this is what the deity Flame Treasury understands.
All the oceans of the various practices of sentient beings, the World-Honored One fully knows them in a single thought;
such vast and unimpeded wisdom, the deity Sublime Adornment is able to awaken to and enter.
Constantly proclaiming the Tathāgata’s tranquil and wondrous voice, Universally giving rise to peerless and great joy;
Causing all to awaken according to their understanding and desires— This is the Dharma practiced by the Thunderous Voice.
The Tathāgata manifests great supernormal powers, Pervading all lands throughout the ten directions.
The Buddha, in his past cultivation, caused all to see this gateway of universal fragrant light;
for those sentient beings who are deceitful, do not cultivate virtue, and are deluded, sinking and flowing within birth and death,
he reveals for them the path of manifold wisdom— this is what the spirit Sublime Light has seen.
For the sake of sentient beings hindered by karmic obstructions, the Buddha appears only once in tens of millions of eons;
yet he causes them to see him constantly in every thought-moment. This is what the spirit Flavor-Light observes.
Furthermore, the mountain spirit Jewel-Peak-Flower-Blossom-Master attains the liberation door of the light of entering the great samādhi of tranquility.

The mountain spirit Forest of Wondrous Topknots attained the liberation door of cultivating roots of goodness through compassion to bring an inconceivable number of sentient beings to maturity and liberation.
The mountain spirit High Banner Universally Illuminating attained the liberation door of observing the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings to adorn and purify their faculties.
The mountain spirit Jewel Topknot Free from Dust attained [the liberation door of] the ocean of infinite eons.
The mountain spirit named Sovereign of Radiance Illumining the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of diligent vigor without weariness or indolence;
the mountain spirit named Sovereign of Great Power Radiance attained the liberation door of being able to mature oneself and further causing sentient beings to abandon delusion and practice the path;
the mountain spirit named Sovereign of Universal Majesty of Awesome Light [attained the liberation door of... [Note: The source text appears to be truncated at the end of the third spirit's name.]
The mountain spirit named Lord of the Subtle and Secret Light-Circle obtained the liberation door of uprooting all suffering so that none remains.
The mountain spirit named Lord of the Universal Eye’s Manifest Vision obtained the liberation door of manifesting the light of the teaching to reveal the merits of all Tathāgatas.

The mountain spirit named Lord of Increasing Roots of Goodness for All Sentient Beings, Even in Dreams, obtained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to increase their roots of goodness even within their dreams.
The Mountain Deity named Door-Vajra-Firm-Eye-Master attained the liberation door called "Manifesting the Ocean of Boundless Great Meaning.
At that time, the Mountain Deity named Flower-Enveloping-Lord, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority,
surveyed the entire assembly of mountain deities and spoke in verse:
In the past, you cultivated supreme practices without limit; now, you have attained immeasurable supernormal powers.
You have extensively opened up Dharma gates as numerous as atoms, causing all sentient beings to deeply awaken and rejoice.
Your body is adorned with various marks that pervade the world, and the light from every pore is utterly pure.
Through great compassion and skillful means, he reveals all things; The Buddha of the Wondrous Topknot of Flower Forests has awakened to this gate.
The Buddha-body manifests everywhere without limit, Filling all worlds throughout the ten directions.
His faculties are pure and adorned, bringing joy to all who see him; This lofty banner of Dharma can be entered through awakening.
Diligently practicing through kalpas without weariness, Untainted by worldly dharmas like empty space, He employs various skillful means to transform all beings;
One who awakens to this Dharma-gate is named Ratnaśikhin.
Sentient beings, blind and ignorant, enter perilous paths; The Buddha, out of compassion for them, extends his light to illuminate them.
Universally causing the world to awaken from sleep, Through majestic light, they realize this mind and give rise to joy.
Having practiced extensively throughout all realms of existence, They made offerings to Buddhas as numerous as atoms in a land;
Causing sentient beings to see them and resolve upon the Great Vow, On this stage, they enter with great power and clear insight.
Seeing all sentient beings wandering in suffering, Constantly entangled and shrouded by all karmic obstacles,

He utterly eradicates them with the light of wisdom. This liberation of the Universal Victorious Deity Issues forth wondrous sounds from every single pore, Praising all Buddhas in accordance with the minds of sentient beings.
Pervading all directions throughout immeasurable eons—this is the gateway entered by the wheel of light.
The Buddha appears everywhere throughout the ten directions, universally manifesting before all;
through various skillful means he expounds the wondrous Dharma, extensively benefiting the ocean of all sentient beings' practices. This is what the deity Pratyakṣadarśin has realized.
The Dharma-gates are like the ocean, boundless and immeasurable; with a single voice they are explained so that all may understand.
Expounded throughout all kalpas without exhaustion, those who enter these skillful means are the Vajra-Eyed.
Furthermore, the Earth-Ruling Spirit named Universal Virtue Pure Flower, with a heart of loving-kindness and compassion, contemplates all things universally in every thought-moment.
The earth goddess Firm Merit Adornment of the Liberation Gate of Sentient Beings attained the liberation gate of the power to universally manifest the merit of all sentient beings;
the earth goddess Exquisite Flower-Adorned Tree attained the liberation gate of universally entering all dharmas to give rise to the adornments of all Buddha-fields;
the earth goddess Universally Scattering Myriad Jewels attained the cultivation of various...
The earth-ruling spirit Time-Master obtained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to remove hindrances and defilements through various samādhis and pure vision;
the earth-ruling spirit Golden-Eyed Obtained the liberation door of manifesting all pure bodies to discipline sentient beings;
the earth-ruling spirit Fragrant-Hair-Radiance... [obtained the liberation door of... *Note: The source text appears to be truncated.*
The earth goddess Jñānavatī attained the liberation door of the great majestic power that knows the ocean of all Buddhas' merits;
the earth goddess Praśāntaghoṣāhlādanī attained the liberation door of universally sustaining the ocean of the speech and sounds of all sentient beings;
the earth goddess Sukusumāvartamaulī attained the liberation door of the stainless nature that fills the Buddha-fields; [and] Vajrasamantadharā.

The Earth-Ruling Goddess Sarvabuddhadharmacakrasaṃdhāraṇasamantamukhaprādurbhāva attained the liberation door of universal manifestation sustained by the wheel of the Dharma of all Buddhas. At that time,
the Earth-Ruling Goddess Samantaguṇaviśuddhikusuma, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed the entire assembly of earth-ruling goddesses and spoke in verse:
In every thought-moment of the past, the Tathāgata’s gateways of great compassion were unspeakable;
having thus practiced without end, he attained this firm and indestructible body,
which contains all the gathered merits of the sentient beings and bodhisattvas of the three periods of time.
Manifesting within every pore of the Tathāgata, Having seen this, Puṇyavyūha gives rise to joy;
The samādhi of vast, tranquil stillness, Reveals to sentient beings a pure land that is neither born nor extinguished, Without coming or going— this is the liberation of the Tree Flower Deity.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated all practices To cause sentient beings to dissolve their heavy obstructions.
The Earth-Ruling Goddess, Mistress of All Jewels, Seeing this liberation, gives rise to joy.
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless; In every thought-moment, it appears universally throughout the world.
The Earth-Ruling Spirit Pure-Eye-Contemplating, seeing the Buddha’s conduct, rejoices in her heart;
With infinite and inconceivable sublime voices, she universally extinguishes the afflictions of all sentient beings.
The Spirit Golden-Eye-Penetrating, having realized and understood, Beholds the Buddha’s boundless and supreme merits.
All forms and appearances are manifested through transformation, filling the Dharma-realm throughout the ten directions.
From fragrant hairs, light radiates as he constantly beholds the Buddha; thus he universally transforms all sentient beings.
His wondrous voice pervades the ten directions, preaching for the sake of the multitudes throughout immeasurable eons.
The earth goddess Manojñā understands this in her mind; having heard it from the Buddha, she feels profound reverence and joy.
From the pores of the Buddha’s body, clouds of fragrant flames emerge, pervading the world according to the minds of sentient beings;
all who behold them are brought to maturity. This is the sphere of vision perceived by Puṣpāvarta.
Firm and indestructible like a vajra, Unshakable beyond Mount Sumeru, The Buddha’s body abides thus in the world;
All who behold it and receive its support give rise to joy.
Furthermore, the City-Ruling Spirit Radiant Jewel-Peak attained the liberation door of skillful means for benefiting sentient beings.
The City-Ruling Goddess of Adorned Palaces attained the liberation door of knowing the faculties of sentient beings to teach, mature, and liberate them;
the City-Ruling Goddess Pure Joy-Jewel attained the liberation door of constant joy that causes all sentient beings to receive various merits and virtues;
the City-Ruling Goddess Pure Freedom from Sorrow attained the liberation door of the treasury of great compassion that rescues all from fear. The Flower... [attained... the liberation door.
The City-Ruling Spirit Lamp-Flame Eye attained the liberation door of attaining the great wisdom of universal clarity;
the City-Ruling Spirit Flame-Banner Radiance attained the liberation door of manifesting universal skillful means;

the City-Ruling Spirit Abundant Merit and Majestic Light attained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings and causing them to cultivate a vast ocean of merit. Pure Radiance...
The City-Ruling Spirit Body-Master attained the liberation door of awakening all ignorant and dark sentient beings;
the City-Ruling Spirit Fragrance-Tuft Adornment attained the liberation door of observing the Tathāgata’s power of mastery to universally tame sentient beings throughout the world;
and the City-Ruling Spirit Jewel-Peak Radiant Eye attained the liberation door of being able to shatter the obstructions of all sentient beings with great light.

The Liberation Gate of Obstructing Mountains. At that time, the City-Ruling Spirit Jewel Peak Radiance, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed all the hosts of city-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
The Guide is thus inconceivable; his radiance shines everywhere throughout the ten directions.
Sentient beings see the Buddha appearing before them, teaching and bringing to maturity countless multitudes whose faculties are each distinct; the Buddha knows them all without exception.
The City-Ruling Spirit Sublime Adorned Palace, having entered this Dharma-door, rejoices in her heart.

She has practiced for immeasurable eons; she protects and upholds the teachings of all Buddhas of the past, constantly serving them with a mind of joy. The Spirit of the Wondrous Jewel City has awakened to this door.

The Tathāgata has long since been able to dispel all the fears of sentient beings, while constantly giving rise to loving-kindness and compassion toward them. This goddess Viśokā’s mind awakens to joy;
the Buddha-wisdom is vast and boundless, like space, which cannot be measured.
The deity of the city of Puṣpākṣa attained awakening and joy; Able to learn the Tathāgata’s wondrous wisdom, The Tathāgata’s physical marks and signs are like those of all sentient beings;
According to their inclinations and desires, he causes them all to see him.
The flaming banner appears clearly, and his mind is able to awaken; Practicing these skillful means, he gives rise to great joy.

The Tathāgata, having cultivated an ocean of manifold merits in the past, possesses a banner of merit—pure, vast, and boundless—the light of which shines upon this gateway; observing and fully awakening to it, his heart rejoices.
Yet sentient beings, deluded and ignorant within the various realms of existence, are like those born blind in this world who suddenly see nothing at all.
The Buddha arises in the world for the benefit of beings; The deity Pure Light enters this gate.
The Tathāgata’s mastery is boundless; Like clouds, he pervades the entire world, Even manifesting in dreams to bring them to discipline— This is what the deity Fragrant Banner beholds.
Sentient beings are shrouded in the darkness of ignorance like the blind;
Enveloped by various hindrances and obscurations, The Buddha’s light shines through them all, causing them to open wide.
Such is the entry of Ratnaśikhara; furthermore, the site-deity Viśuddhavyūhadhvaja attained the manifestation of vast and magnificent offerings for the Buddha.
The liberation door of the Sumeru Jewel Light Ritual Ground Deity, who attains the fulfillment of vast bodhisattva practices by appearing before all sentient beings through the power of her vows;

the liberation door of the Thunder-Sound Banner Ritual Ground Deity, who causes all sentient beings to see the Buddha according to their hearts' desires and have him preach the Dharma within their dreams; and the Flower-Rain [Deity].
The Dharma-door of the Sanctuary Spirit Sublime Eye, who has attained the liberation of being able to rain down all manner of difficult-to-renounce precious ornaments;
the Dharma-door of the Sanctuary Spirit Pure Flame Form, who has attained the liberation of manifesting exquisite adornments to widely transform sentient beings and bring them to maturity;

and the Dharma-door of the Sanctuary Spirit Flower Garland Hanging Topknot, who has attained the power to preach the Dharma according to their faculties so that they may give rise to right [understanding].
The Dharma-Field Spirit named Mindfulness of the Gates of Liberation attained the liberation door of being able to universally rain down the Dharma of boundless joy through eloquence;
the Dharma-Field Spirit named Courageous Fragrant Eye attained the liberation door of extensively praising the merits of all Buddhas;
and the Dharma-Field Spirit named Vajra-Colored Cloud attained the liberation door of manifesting trees adorned with boundless forms and colors.

The Dharma-door of Liberation of the Ritual Ground Deity Arrayed Path: Attaining the liberation of remaining tranquil and unmoving beneath the Bodhi tree while pervading the ten directions; the Dharma-door of Liberation of the Ritual Ground Deity Radiant Lotus Light:
Attaining the liberation of manifesting the various powers of the Tathāgata. At that time, the Ritual Ground Deity Banner of Pure Adornment, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power...
The Power Universal Observer addressed the assembly of all shrine deities (*maṇḍala-devatā*) with these verses:
"I recall that in the past, throughout immeasurable eons, the Tathāgata practiced his various austerities;
he made offerings to all Buddhas who appeared in the world, and thereby attained great merit as vast as space."
In the past, the Buddha practiced inexhaustible giving; The number of world-systems is like the atoms of Mount Sumeru.
The Radiant Light Bodhi Deity, Recalling the Sugata, rejoices in his heart.
The Tathāgata’s physical marks are without end; His emanations circulate through all lands.
Even within dreams, you constantly manifest; Seeing this, Thunder-Banner, I am filled with joy.
In past eons, you practiced the perfection of giving for immeasurable ages; You were able to give away what is most difficult to give, such as eyes like the ocean.
Through such acts of giving for the sake of sentient beings, This Eye of Subtle Virtue can awaken and gladden me.
Clouds of jewel flames with boundless forms and colors appear throughout the world at the site of enlightenment;
the pure path-dwelling deity of the flame-form rejoices upon seeing the Buddha’s sovereign power.
The ocean of sentient beings’ conduct is without limit, yet the Buddha universally encompasses them all, raining down the rain of Dharma.
According to their faculties, they resolve doubts; Through this flower-garland, they awaken to this mind with immeasurable joy.
The distinctions of the various dharma-gates and the ocean of eloquence— They are able to enter them all.
The deity of the site, Adorned with Rain of Jewels, Constantly maintains this state in every thought-moment of the mind.
Because he has praised the Buddha with all the words and expressions throughout the world in unspeakably many lands,
this Heroic Eye has attained the great merit of renown;
he can recollect various forms and infinite trees, universally appearing beneath the King of Bodhi Trees.
Vajra-Rainbow-Cloud realized this gate, Constantly contemplating the Bodhi tree, he gives rise to joy.
The limits of the ten directions cannot be found, And the Buddha’s wisdom at the site of enlightenment is likewise so.
With the pure faith of Lotus-Step-Light, Entering this liberation, he gives rise to profound joy.

All within the site of enlightenment emits wondrous sounds, praising the Buddha’s inconceivable power of purity and his accomplishment of all causal practices; this divine spirit Sublime Light is able to hear and receive them.
Furthermore, the footstep-following spirit Jewel Seal obtains the liberation of universally raining down all manner of jewels and giving rise to vast joy.

The footstep-following spirit Padmaprabha attained the liberation door of manifesting the body of a Buddha seated upon a lotus throne of all radiant colors to bring joy and liberation to those who behold him;

the footstep-following spirit Varasragdharā attained the liberation door of establishing the assemblies and sites of enlightenment of all Tathāgatas within every single thought-moment; and the footstep-following spirit Sarvasudarśana attained [the liberation door] of gathering all virtuous visions.
The footstep-moving spirit Divine Ability to Lift Feet and Take Steps attained the liberation door of thoroughly taming boundless sentient beings with every step he takes.

The footstep-moving spirit Wondrous Jewel Star Banner attained the liberation door of manifesting various lotus net radiances in every thought-moment, universally raining down all kinds of jewels and emitting sublime sounds.
The footstep-moving spirit Delight in Uttering Sublime Sounds attained the birth of boundless joy.
The footstep-following spirit Tree Light of Sandalwood attained the liberation door of universally awakening all assemblies at the site of enlightenment with fragrant winds.
The footstep-following spirit Lotus Radiance attained the liberation door of emitting light from every pore to proclaim the subtle and wondrous sound of the Dharma.
The footstep-following spirit Subtle Radiance attained the liberation door of her own body... [attaining the liberation door of] its body.
The liberation door of universally emitting various nets of light that shine everywhere was attained by the footstep-following spirit *Saṃcitamanojñakusumapāda*;
the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to awaken and give rise to an ocean of roots of goodness was attained by the footstep-following spirit *Ratnamudrāpāṇi*.
At that time, the footstep-following spirit *Ratnamudrāpāṇi*, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of footstep-following spirits and spoke in verse:

In the past, throughout immeasurable kalpas, the Buddha practiced the path, making offerings to all Tathāgatas with a heart always joyful and never weary. His gateway of joy is as deep and vast as the ocean;
his supernormal powers in every thought-moment are unfathomable, manifesting lotuses of various fragrances.
The Buddha sits upon it, traveling everywhere; the red-hued Radiance Deity beholds them all.

Such is the Dharma of the Buddhas, the Tathāgatas: throughout the vast assemblies pervading the ten directions, the universal manifestation of the Buddhas is inconceivable. The Supreme Flower Deity gazes clearly upon them all.
Throughout all lands in the ten directions, wherever they lift their feet or set them down, they are able to bring all sentient beings to fulfillment.
This deity, Sudarśana, rejoices with a mind awakened to this truth;
manifesting bodies as numerous as all living beings, each and every one of these bodies fills the entire Dharma-realm.
They emit pure light everywhere and rain down a multitude of jewels; such liberation as the Star Banner enters the boundless realm of the Tathāgata.
Universally raining the rain of Dharma, they fill the entire assembly;
beholding the Buddha, all give rise to joy—this is what the one of Wondrous Sound perceives.
The Buddha’s voice is equal in measure to empty space; all sounds are contained within it.
There is nowhere that the taming of sentient beings does not pervade.
Thus, from every pore of this sandalwood [statue], emanated voices can be heard, proclaiming the names of all Buddhas of the three periods of time.
All who hear this sound rejoice; thus does the deity Padmaprabha behold the inconceivable manifestations of the Buddha’s body.
At every step, his physical forms are like the ocean, appearing to all according to the minds of sentient beings—this is what is attained through this wondrous radiance.
Universally manifesting great spiritual powers throughout the ten directions, causing all sentient beings to attain awakening;
the Spirit of Myriad Wondrous Flowers, having seen this Dharma, felt great joy in her heart.
Furthermore, the Spirit of the Body of the Realm of Pure Joy attained the liberation door of recollecting the ocean of the Buddha’s past vows.
The body-spirit Light Illuminating the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of obtaining a radiance that universally illuminates boundless worlds;
the body-spirit Ocean-Sound Subduing attained the liberation door of obtaining a great voice that universally awakens all sentient beings, causing them to rejoice and be subdued;
the body-spirit Pure Flower Adorned Topknot attained the liberation door of a body like space that dwells pervasively everywhere.
The host of deities of the Gate of Immeasurable Dignified Postures attained the liberation door of manifesting to all sentient beings the realm of liberation of all Buddhas;
the host of deities of the Body of Supreme Radiance Adornment attained the liberation door of causing all famished sentient beings to have their physical strength and vitality fully satisfied;
the host of deities of the Body of Pure Light Fragrant Clouds attained the liberation door of removing the defilements of affliction from all sentient beings.
The body-guarding spirits of the Gate of Liberation attained the liberation door of turning away the demonic activities of ignorance in all sentient beings;
the body-guarding spirits of Universal Manifestation attained the liberation door of universally displaying majestic adornments within the palaces of all world-protectors;
and the body-guarding spirits of Immovable Radiance attained the liberation door of universally gathering all assemblies.
The liberation door of causing all beings to give rise to pure roots of goodness.
At that time, the Body-Host Spirit named Pure Joy Realm, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the assemblies of body-host spirits and spoke in verse:
I recall that in an eon as vast as the dust motes of Mount Sumeru, a Buddha named Sublime Light appeared in the world.
At the presence of that Tathāgata, the World-Honored One resolved his mind to make offerings to all Buddhas.
The bodies of those Tathāgatas emitted great rays of light, and those lights pervaded the entire Dharma-realm without exception.
Sentient beings who encounter it find their minds tamed; this is what the deity Zhàofāng perceives.
The Tathāgata’s voice resounds through the lands of the ten directions, all vocal sounds being perfectly complete.
It universally awakens all living beings without exception; those who hear this and are tamed rejoice in their hearts.
The Buddha’s body is pure and eternally quiescent; He universally manifests all colors yet remains free of all marks.
Thus he dwells pervasively throughout the world— This is the entryway of the goddess Viśuddhāmbujā.
The Guide is thus inconceivable; According to the minds of sentient beings, he causes them all to see him.
Whether sitting, walking, or sometimes standing—through these immeasurable modes of conduct, one awakens to the gateways of the Dharma.

A Buddha is difficult to encounter even in hundreds of thousands of eons; appearing in the world for the benefit of others with sovereign power, he enables all beings to leave behind the suffering of poverty.
Thus does the Most Victorious One, Resplendent with Light, enter this place.
Between each of the Tathāgata’s teeth, clouds of fragrant lamp-flames are universally emitted,
extinguishing the delusions of all sentient beings. The deity Vimalamegha saw that sentient beings are heavily obstructed by defilements and delusions, constantly wandering along the paths of Māra.
The Tathāgata reveals the path of liberation; Guarding and upholding it, one can enter my contemplation.
Through the sovereign power of the Tathāgata, light is spread, Filling the entire Dharma-realm.
Dwelling in royal palaces to transform sentient beings— This is the sphere of the Spirit of Universal Manifestation.
Sentient beings, deluded and possessed of manifold sufferings, The Buddha dwells among them, constantly providing protection;
Causing all to extinguish delusions and give rise to a joyful mind— This is what the deity Immovable Light beheld.
Furthermore, the Vajra-holder deity Varṇasundara Nārāyaṇa Beheld the Tathāgata manifesting boundless forms.
The Vajra-holder Sun-Disc Swift Banner attained the liberation door of manifesting from every single pore of the Buddha’s body clouds of various radiances like sun-discs.
The Vajra-holder Sumeru Flower Light attained the liberation door of the great supernormal power of manifesting infinite bodies. The Vajra-holder Pure Cloud Sound...
The Vajrapāṇi Lord of the Celestial Arm acquired the liberation door of attaining infinite voices that accord with all types of beings;
the Vajrapāṇi of Delightful Radiance acquired the liberation door of manifesting as the lord of all worlds to awaken sentient beings;
and the Great [Vajrapāṇi] acquired the liberation door of universally revealing the distinctions of all Buddha-dharmas without exception or omission.
The Vajrapāṇi deity Drum-rasita attained the liberation door of gathering all tree deities through delightful and beautiful ornaments;
the Vajrapāṇi deity Siṃharāja-prabhāsa attained the liberation door of fully understanding the vast mass of the Tathāgata’s merit and adornments;
the Vajrapāṇi deity Guhya-jvālā-śrī-nayana attained the universal... [liberation door].
The liberation door of manifesting a majestic body to observe the minds of beings who are steeped in evil was attained by the Vajrapāṇi Lotus Maṇi Topknot;
the liberation door of universally raining down all ornaments for Bodhisattvas was attained by the Vajrapāṇi Maṇi Topknot of Exquisite Color.
At that time, the Vajrapāṇi Maṇi Topknot of Exquisite Color, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, universally surveyed all the Vajrapāṇis.
The assembly of Vajra deities spoke these verses:
"You should contemplate the Dharma King; The nature of the Dharma King is thus: His physical marks are boundless, appearing everywhere throughout the world.
Within each and every pore of the Buddha’s body, There are inconceivable nets of light."

Just as the pure solar disc Shines universally upon the lands of the ten directions, So too does the Tathāgata’s power of supernormal knowledge pervade the entire dharma-realm. Before all sentient beings, he manifests inexhaustible bodies;
The sound of the Tathāgata’s preaching of the Dharma Is heard by none throughout the ten directions, According to the various types of sentient beings.
Causing all hearts to be fully satisfied, the Multitude beholds the Honored Muni dwelling within the palaces of the world.

For the sake of all living beings, he proclaims the Great Dharma. Abiding in the swirling depths of the ocean of Dharma, he expounds the infinite meanings of all distinctions through various gates of skillful means, his teaching never coming to an end.
With boundless great skillful means, you universally respond to the lands of the ten directions;
wherever they encounter the Buddha’s pure light, all behold the body of the Tathāgata. They make offerings to the Buddhas, as numerous as the atoms within billions of lands;
your merit is like space, that which all gaze upon with reverence; the power of your spiritual penetrations is impartial.
All lands appear therein, as they sit peacefully within the sublime site of enlightenment;

They manifest universally before all beings, and clouds of flames illuminate the world everywhere. With various lights perfectly complete, reaching every corner of the Dharma-realm, they reveal the sphere of activity of the Buddhas.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra enters the ocean of skillful means of inconceivable doors of liberation and enters the ocean of the Tathāgata’s merits.

That is to say, there is a door of liberation named "Adorning and Purifying All Buddha-Lands and Subduing Sentient Beings so They Ultimately Attain Deliverance," and there is a door of liberation named "Universally Visiting the Abodes of All Tathāgatas."
There is a liberation door named "The Realm of Cultivating Fulfillment of Merit"; a liberation door named "Establishing All Bodhisattva Stages and the Ocean of Great Vows";
a liberation door named "Universally Manifesting Infinite Bodies as Numerous as the Microscopic Dust-Particles of the Dharma Realm";
and a liberation door named "Expounding the Inconceivable Number of Distinct Names Pervading All Lands."
There is a liberation door named "Manifesting the Boundless Supernormal Powers of All Bodhisattvas within Every Single Atom.
There is a liberation door named "Perceiving in a Single Thought-Moment the Events of the Formation and Destruction of the Kalpas of the Three Times.
There is a liberation door named "Manifesting the Ocean of All Bodhisattvas' Faculties, Each Entering Its Own Sphere. There is a liberation door named "Able to..."
Through the power of spiritual transformations, he manifested various bodies pervading the boundless Dharma-realm.
There is a gate of liberation called "The Gate Displaying the Successive Stages of All Bodhisattva Practices and Entering the Vast Expedient Means of Omniscience.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra, by means of his own merit and further sustained by the majestic spiritual power of the Tathāgata, universally...
Having surveyed the ocean-like assembly, he spoke these verses:
"In the vast buddha-field adorned by the Buddha, Filled with pure sons of the Buddha as numerous as all atoms,
He rains down the inconceivable and most sublime Dharma."
Just as one sees the Buddha seated in this assembly, so it is in all atoms;
the Buddha-body neither goes nor comes, yet all lands are clearly manifested therein.
This reveals the practices cultivated by Bodhisattvas and the infinite skillful means of the stages and paths.

And he expounds the inconceivable, true principle, causing all sons of the Buddha to enter the Dharma-realm and manifest transformation-buddhas as numerous as motes of dust; universally responding to the desires of all sentient beings,
he enters the gateway of skillful means into the profound Dharma-realm, extensively unfolding and proclaiming it in its vastness and boundlessness.
The Tathāgata’s names are equal to those in the world, pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
no skillful means of his ever go in vain, for he tames sentient beings so they are all freed from defilement.
Within every single atom of dust, the Buddha manifests boundless great supernormal powers.
Seated entirely within the site of enlightenment, they are able to expound upon the Buddha’s past practices for awakening;
throughout all vast eons of the three periods of time, the Buddha manifests within every single thought-moment all matters of formation and destruction—
there is nothing that his inconceivable wisdom does not comprehend.
The assembly of the Buddha’s sons is vast and limitless; To attempt to measure the stages of all Buddhas, And to fully comprehend the boundless Dharma-gates of the Buddhas, Is exceedingly difficult.
The Buddha is like space, free from discrimination; Equal to the true Dharma-realm, he has no dependence.
Manifesting emanations that travel everywhere without exception, They all sit at the site of enlightenment and realize perfect buddhahood.
With wondrous voices, the Buddhas proclaim and expound extensively, Thoroughly clarifying all the stages of the bodhisattva paths.
Appearing universally before each and every sentient being, They bestow upon them all the Dharma equal to that of the Tathāgata.

Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Pure Virtue Sublime Light attained the liberation door of "universally proceeding to the assemblies of bodhisattvas throughout the ten directions to adorn the sites of enlightenment.

The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Virtue Supreme Lamp Radiance attained the liberation door of "manifesting the attainment of perfect enlightenment in an instant to teach and mature inconceivable realms of sentient beings."
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Radiance Lion Banner attained the liberation door of cultivating the bodhisattva’s adornment of merit and giving birth to all buddha-lands;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Jewel Flame Sublime Light attained the liberation door of observing the realm of a buddha’s supernormal powers without confusion; [and] Universal Sound Virtue...
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sāgaradhvaja attained the liberation door of manifesting the adornments of all Buddha-lands within a single assembly’s site of enlightenment;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantaprajñābhāsa attained the liberation door of following the Tathāgata to observe the treasury of the profound and vast Dharma-realm; the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabodhimanorathasvara attained the liberation door of... [the sound that universally awakens and delights].

The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva attained the liberation door of "The Treasury of Offerings for Serving and Attending All Buddhas, Universally Pure and of Inexhaustible Merit and Majestic Light. The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva attained the liberation door of "The Vast Empowerment that Produces All Spiritual Transformations.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantaratna-cūḍa-kusuma-dhvaja attained the [liberation door] of "Universal Entry."

The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Mark Supreme Light, who gives birth to the boundless gates of conduct for all beings in the world through the practice of giving rise to the bodhisattva’s infinite gates of conduct,
attained the liberation gate of being able to manifest the spheres of all Buddhas within the signless realm of phenomena (*dharmadhātu*).
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Pure Virtue Subtle Light, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power...
Having universally observed the ocean of liberation gates of all bodhisattvas, he then spoke these verses:
All the lands throughout the ten directions, Are entirely purified in a single instant.
Turning the wheel of Dharma with wondrous sounds, They pervade the world, peerless and unequaled.
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless; in a single thought-moment, it completely fills the entire dharma-realm.
Within every single atom, he establishes a site of enlightenment and fully realizes bodhi, manifesting miraculous transformations.
World-Honored One, in the past you cultivated all practices throughout hundreds of thousands of immeasurable kalpas.
All Buddha-fields are adorned, appearing unimpeded like space;
The Buddha’s power of spiritual transformations is limitless, Filling all infinite eons.
Even if one were to pass through immeasurable eons, Observing them moment by moment without weariness.
You should contemplate the Buddha’s realm of supernormal power: The lands of the ten directions are all adorned and purified;
All of these appear here before you, In infinite varieties, differing from moment to moment.
Even if one contemplates the Buddha for hundreds of thousands of immeasurable eons, One cannot grasp even the limit of a single pore.
The Tathāgata’s gate of unimpeded skillful means— this light shines universally upon inconceivable lands.
Having served oceans of boundless Buddhas throughout past eons while dwelling in the world,
all beings now rush toward him like rivers to the sea, coming to make offerings to the World-Honored One.
The Tathāgata appears throughout the ten directions; within every single atom are infinite lands, and the realms therein are all immeasurable, each abiding for boundless and inexhaustible eons.
In past kalpas, for the sake of sentient beings, the Buddha cultivated an ocean of boundless great compassion.
Following all sentient beings into birth and death, you universally transform the assemblies to bring them to purity;
the Buddha abides in the treasury of the *tathatā* dharma-realm, signless, formless, and free from all defilements.
Sentient beings perceive various bodies, whereby all sufferings and difficulties are entirely extinguished.

Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sāgaraprabhāmahāvyūha attained the liberation door of the clouds of sounds and oceanic lights that give birth to the various stages and perfections of bodhisattvas,
teaching and transforming sentient beings, and purifying all Buddha-lands;
and the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Vimalagarbha attained the liberation door of universally entering the Dharma-realm in every thought-moment.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Jewel-Crested (Ratnaśikhin) attained the gate of liberation that gives rise to the wisdom of discerning various distinctions;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Pure Light Sovereign of Merit (Vimalaprabhā-guṇeśvararāja) attained the gate of liberation that manifests pure great merit before all sentient beings for inconceivable eons;
and [the Bodhisattva] attained the universal vision of the initial [vows] of all Bodhisattvas in the ten directions.
When approaching the site of enlightenment (*bodhimaṇḍa*), the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Suvīra-padma-śekhara attained the liberation door of various adornments;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samanta-jñāna-megha-sūrya-dhvaja attained the liberation door of universally manifesting all Buddha-dharmas by following the ocean of the faculties and understandings of all sentient beings;
and [the Bodhisattva] attained the liberation door of accomplishing the wisdom of the Tathāgata and dwelling forever in the unconditioned.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Great Vīrya-Vajranābhi attained the liberation door of the power of the seal that universally enters all boundless dharmas;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Gandhārcis-ketu attained the liberation door of manifesting the initial cultivation of the bodhisattva path by all Buddhas of the present, up until the fulfillment of the accumulation of wisdom.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Gate of Great Radiant Virtue and Profound Beautiful Sound attained the liberation door of dwelling securely in the ocean of all the great vows of Vairocana;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Great Light of Merit and Wisdom-Birth attained the liberation door of manifesting the profound realm of the Tathāgata that pervades the entire Dharma-realm. At that time, the Bodhisattva Ocean-Light Moon-Great Radiance...
The Mahāsattva, having universally surveyed the ocean of the adornments of all the bodhisattva assemblies by virtue of the Buddha’s majestic power,
spoke these verses:
“The perfections and the stages, vast and inconceivable, are all fully perfected.”
Infinite sentient beings are all tamed, And all Buddha-lands are purified and adorned.
Just as the Buddhas teach and transform the realms of beings, The lands of the ten directions are entirely filled.
Within a single thought-moment, the Wheel of Dharma is turned, Universally responding to the sentiments of all, reaching everywhere without exception.
Throughout immeasurable and vast eons, the Buddha universally manifests before all sentient beings;
just as he extensively practiced and cultivated in the past, he reveals to them the pure realms of his conduct.
I behold all ten directions without exception, and I also see all Buddhas manifesting their spiritual powers.
All sit at the site of enlightenment to achieve perfect awakening, surrounded by assemblies who hear the Dharma.
The vast and brilliant body of the Buddha’s Dharma can manifest in the world through skillful means,
universally according with the inclinations of sentient beings' minds, raining down the Dharma in accordance with their respective faculties.
The body of true suchness is equal and signless; The stainless, radiant, pure dharma-body;
The immeasurable body of tranquil wisdom; Universally responding throughout the ten directions to expound the Dharma.
The powers of the Dharma King are all purified; Wisdom is like space, without limit.
He reveals everything without omission or concealment, causing all sentient beings to awaken and enter therein together.
Just as the Buddha practiced and cultivated in the past until he attained all-encompassing wisdom,
so now he emits light that pervades the entire Dharma-realm, manifesting within it all with perfect clarity.
The Buddha manifests spiritual powers through his original vows, such that there is nowhere throughout the ten directions that is not illuminated.
Just as the Buddha cultivated his practices in the past, he expounds them all within the net of light;
the realms of the ten directions are inexhaustible, each distinct, peerless, and boundless.
The Buddha’s unimpeded power emits a great light, Making all lands clearly manifest.
[Commentary] All the aforementioned assemblies have been praised according to their meaning and categorized by their significance to extol the vastness of the teaching;
there is no need for excessive textual detail, for once one grasps the intent, it is attained. Within this first assembly, there are forty-seven groups.
The preceding seven assemblies have already been explained.
