Chapter Five, Part Two: The World of Flower Treasury.
[Sūtra] At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva again addressed the great assembly, saying: "O Sons of the Buddha, what kinds of worlds are contained herein?

I shall now explain them to you. O Sons of the Buddha, within these seas of fragrant water, which are as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakable numbers of buddha-fields, there abide world-systems as numerous as the atoms in ten unspeakable numbers of buddha-fields."
Within a single world-system, there are again as many world-seeds as there are atoms in ten unspeakable numbers of Buddha-fields, O Sons of the Buddha.
Those various world-seeds each abide upon the ocean of worlds according to their respective locations;
they each have their respective shapes, their respective natures, their respective positions, their respective modes of entry, their respective adornments, and their respective boundaries.
In each and every row there is no distinction; through the empowerment of their respective powers, O Sons of the Buddha,
these world-systems may rest upon a great sea of lotuses, or upon a sea of jewel-flowers of boundless colors,
or upon a sea of precious necklaces from a treasury of all pearls, or upon seas of fragrant water, or upon—
There are oceans of all kinds of flowers that abide in various ways: some abide supported by oceans of mani-jewel nets;
some abide supported by oceans of revolving flowing light; some abide supported by oceans of bodhisattva jewel-adorned crowns;
some abide supported by oceans of the bodies of various sentient beings; and some abide supported by oceans of mani-jewel kings of the voices of all Buddhas. Such as these...
To speak extensively: there are sons of the Buddha, as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds.

Among all those world-systems, some are shaped like Mount Sumeru, some like rivers, some like whirlpools, some like eddies, some like wheel-rims, some like sacrificial altars, some like groves of trees, and some like multi-storied pavilions.
The forms may be made in the shape of mountain banners, or in the shape of universal squares, or in the shape of the *garbhadhātu*, or in the shape of lotuses,
or in the shape of *kharaka* vessels, or in the shape of sentient beings, or in the shape of clouds,
or in the shape of the marks and signs of the Buddhas, or in the shape of perfect radiance, or in the shape of various jeweled nets, or they may be made...
The forms of all their gates, or various ornaments, and so forth— if explained in detail—
consist of as many world-ocean atoms as there are, O sons of the Buddha. All those world-systems may have as their substance clouds of mani-jewels from the ten directions,
or they may have as their substance masses of multicolored flames, or they may have as their substance various radiances.
Their substance may consist of the flames of precious incense; or their substance may consist of *tārā* flowers adorned with all kinds of jewels;
or their substance may consist of the images of bodhisattvas; or their substance may consist of the radiance of the Buddhas;
or their substance may consist of the physical marks and signs of the Buddhas; or their substance may consist of the light of a single jewel; or their substance may consist of the multitude...
Its essence may be the light of jewels; or its essence may be the sounds of the ocean of merit of all sentient beings;
or its essence may be the sounds of the ocean of various karmas of all sentient beings; or its essence may be the pure sounds of the realm of all Buddhas;
or its essence may be the sounds of the ocean of great vows of all Bodhisattvas.
Some take as their essence the sounds of the skillful means of all Buddhas;
some take as their essence the sounds of the formation and destruction of the adornments of all lands; some take as their essence the boundless voices of all Buddhas;
some take as their essence the voices of the transformations of all Buddhas; and some take as their essence the virtuous voices of all sentient beings.
The essence [of this teaching] may consist of the pure sounds of the ocean of all Buddhas' virtues;

if explained extensively, such instances are as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds. At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, wishing to restate this meaning, received the Buddha’s spiritual power, surveyed the ten directions, and spoke in verse:
The world-systems are firm, wondrously adorned, vast, pure, and treasuries of radiant light;
they rest upon oceans of lotus jewels, or some rest upon fragrant oceans and the like, formed in the shape of Mount Sumeru or tree-shaped altars; all these world-systems pervade the ten directions.
Various ornaments and distinct forms are each arranged and established;
some have bodies of pure radiance, while others are made of Flower Treasury and jewel-clouds;
some world-systems are formed from flames, abiding within indestructible treasuries of mani-jewels.
Lamp-clouds, flame-paintings, and radiant light, Various and boundless pure colors;
Some have speech and sound as their essence, These are the inconceivable manifestations expounded by the Buddha,
Or sounds produced through the power of his vows, With miraculous transformations as their fundamental nature.
The great meritorious karma of all sentient beings, and likewise the sound of the Buddha’s virtues,
The various distinct gateways of every world-system, inconceivable and inexhaustible—
Thus they pervade all the ten directions; through vast adornments, he manifests his spiritual power.
All the vast lands throughout the ten directions Come entirely into this world-system;
Though they are seen to enter everywhere within it, In truth, there is no coming and no entering.
One land-system enters all, And all enter one, without exception.
The essence and characteristics are as they originally are, without distinction;

equalless and immeasurable, they pervade all lands within the atoms of every realm. Everywhere one sees the Tathāgata within the ocean of his vows, his voice like the roll of thunder, taming all sentient beings.
The Buddha’s body pervades all lands, And is likewise filled with countless bodhisattvas.
The Tathāgata’s sovereign power is peerless, Universally transforming all sentient beings.
[Commentary] From "At that time" onwards, thirty-eight lines of prose and twenty lines of verse clarify the world-systems (*lokadhātu-jāti*).
[Their] essential nature, shape, and basis of abiding.
[Sūtra]: At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva again addressed the great assembly, saying:

"O Sons of the Buddha, these ten oceans of fragrant water, as numerous as the atoms in unspeakable numbers of buddha-fields, exist within the Flower Bank Adorned World-Ocean Sea, like the palaces of the Lord of Devas."
O Sons of the Buddha, these are arranged in a network-like distribution.
In the very center of this is a fragrant ocean named Boundless Light of Exquisite Flowers, which has as its floor a jeweled banner-king that manifests the forms of all bodhisattvas.
From it emerges a great lotus flower named Adorned with All-Fragrant Jewel Kings, upon which rests a world-system named Universally Illuminating the Ten Directions.
The Radiant Jewel Light has all ornaments as its substance; it contains worlds numbering as many as the atoms in ten unspeakable numbers of Buddha-fields, arrayed therein.

At the very bottom is a world named Supreme Light Pervading Illumination, which has a wheel of radiant light adorned with all vajras as its boundary and rests upon flowers of various precious mani-jewels.

It abides there with a form like that of a *maṇi* jewel, its summit covered by clouds of all kinds of jewel-flowers as adornments, and it is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, each established in various ways and adorned in various ways.
The Buddha’s name is Pure Eye Free from Defilement Lamp. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, there is another world.
It is named "Exquisite Array of Various Fragrant Lotuses," bounded by all manner of ornaments and resting upon a network of precious lotus flowers;

its form is like a lion throne, completely covered above by clouds of jeweled canopies in the colors of every kind of gem, and it is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms within two Buddha-fields. The Buddha there is named Lion Light.
Jaya-avabhāsa, above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field,
there is a world named Sarva-ratna-vyūha-samanta-prabhāsa-gandha-māruta-cakra-paryanta-vicitra-ratna-kusuma-hāra-sthita,
which is octagonal in shape and covered by clouds of sun-disks and moons of exquisite light; it has lasted for as many eons as there are atoms in three buddha-fields.
The world-system is surrounded on all sides by the Buddha named Pure Light Wisdom Supreme Banner.

Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with Various Radiant Flowers, which has all kinds of jewel-kings for its boundaries and rests upon an ocean of multicolored vajra-śīla-banners; its shape is like a mani-lotus made of gold.
A cloud of light from *vajra*-mani jewels covers its summit, surrounded on all sides by as many worlds as there are atoms in four buddha-fields;
it is purely and uniformly pure, and the Buddha’s name is Vajraprabhāsa-aparimitavīryasamudgata.
Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Samantamukhapramuktasurucira-padmaprabha.
It is bounded by nets adorned with all kinds of precious bells and rests upon an ocean of jewel-wheel nets adorned with all manner of groves;
its shape is generally square yet possesses many corners, and it is covered above by clouds of Brahma-voice mani-jewel kings.
It is surrounded on all sides by as many worlds as there are atoms in five buddha-fields, and the Buddha there is named Fragrant Light Joyful Power Ocean.

Above, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Pure and Wondrous Radiance, bounded by banners adorned with jewel-kings and resting upon an ocean of diamond palaces;

it is square in shape and covered above by clouds of canopies with topknots of maṇi wheels, and is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms in six buddha-fields. The Buddha’s name is...
Above the world-system called Universal Radiance Sovereign Banner, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with Multitudes of Flower Flames.
It is bordered by various flowers and rests upon an ocean of flames of all jewel colors;
its shape is like that of a multi-storied pavilion, and it is covered by clouds of railings made of pearls and garments of all jewel colors.
Above that, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in seven buddha-fields, there is a world-system called Pure and Solely Radiant,
where the Buddha’s name is Sovereign Light of the Ocean of Joyful Merit and Renown. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field,
there is a world named Ground of the Manifestation of Power, adorned with all-sound-producing mani-jewel kings.
It rested upon a lotus throne of various jewel colors within an ocean of space;
its form was like Indra’s net, covered above by clouds of flower-nets of infinite colors, and it was surrounded on all sides by as many worlds as there are atoms in eight buddha-fields.
The Buddha’s name was Vast Renown Ocean of Wisdom Banner. Beyond this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field...

In a certain world-system, there is a world named "Emanating Exquisite Sounds," which has a wheel adorned with mind-king maṇi-jewels as its boundary and support, and from which clouds of ornaments of all exquisite sounds constantly emerge.
It rests upon an ocean of maṇi-jewel kings, and its form is like that of the body of Brahmā.
It is covered above by lion-throne clouds adorned with immeasurable jewels; therein dwell nine Buddhas.
Surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, the Buddha there is named Pure Moonlight Radiance Mark Unconquerable.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Vajra Banner,
which has a boundary of pearl-treasury necklaces with infinite adornments and rests upon a lion-throne of all-adorned jewels.
It rests upon a sea of *maṇi* jewels, its circular form as vast as the atoms within ten *sumeru* mountains;
it is completely covered by clouds of *sumeru*-like flowers made of all kinds of fragrant *maṇi* jewels, and it is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms within ten buddha-fields.

It is purely and entirely serene, and the Buddha’s name is Sarvadharma-sāgara-vararāja (The Supreme King of the Ocean of All Dharmas). Above this, beyond [the distance of] the atoms of a buddha-field...

In worlds as numerous as atoms of dust, there is a world named Constantly Manifesting Sapphire Radiance, which has a boundary adorned with indestructible, extremely firm diamond and rests upon various extraordinary oceans of flowers;
its shape is like that of a half-moon, and it is covered above by clouds of celestial jewel canopies. [It is as vast as] the atoms of eleven Buddha-fields.
Surrounded on all sides by a multitude of worlds, the Buddha there is named Immeasurable Merit Dharma.

Above this, past as many worlds as atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Radiant Illumination, bounded by Universal Light Adornments and resting upon a Sea of Fragrant Water called Flower Swirl.
It is shaped like a flower swirl and is covered above by various clouds of cloth. 12.
Surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-field, the Buddha there is named Surpassing Śakra and Brahmā.
Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-field, one reaches this world-system called Sahā.
It is bounded by diamond adornments, supported by wind-circles of various colors, and rests upon a lotus-net; its form is like empty space, yet it is universally perfect.
The celestial palaces were adorned with clouds that covered the void above; thirteen world-systems, as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, surrounded it on all sides.
That Buddha was the World-Honored One, Vairocana Tathāgata.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Tranquil Light Free from Dust, composed of all kinds of jewels.
Adorned as its boundary, it rests upon an ocean of various precious garments; its form is like that of Vajrapāṇi, covered above by vajra-clouds of infinite colors.
It is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms in fourteen buddha-fields.
The Buddha there is named Supreme Sound Pervading the Dharma Realm. Beyond this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is...
The world-system is named *Sarvavyūhapaṭṭāntaparyanta-viśuddhakusumajālārṇavasthita* (Abiding upon an Ocean of Pure Flower Nets with All Ornamental Canopies as its Boundary).
Its shape is like that of the svastika, and it is covered above by clouds of *maṇi*-tree fragrant water-oceans.
It is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms within fifteen buddha-fields, and it is purely and uniformly pure. The name of the Buddha is—
Above this world-system, Indestructible Power Universal Radiance Banner, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Pure Light Pervasive Illumination.
It is bounded by a king of *maṇi* jewels from clouds of inexhaustible gems and rests upon a sea of lotuses with various fragrant flames.
Its shape is like the shell of a tortoise, and it is adorned with circles of *maṇi* jewels of radiant light.
Clouds of sandalwood incense cover its summit, surrounded on all sides by as many worlds as there are atoms in sixteen buddha-fields;

the Buddha there is named Pure Sun Virtue Eye. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Jewel Adornment Treasury, which has the mani-kings in the forms of all sentient beings as its boundary and rests upon a treasury of light.
The Mani-Wheel King Ocean abides there, its form octagonal and adorned with the jewels of all the Cakravāḍa mountains;
it is covered above by a net of flowering trees, and is surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms in seventeen buddha-fields.
The Buddha there is named Unobstructed Wisdom Light Shining Throughout the Ten Directions. Beyond this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is...
The world-system is named Free from Dust (*Vigataraja*). It is bounded by all manner of exquisite marks and adorned with a sea of lion thrones made of various wonderful flowers.
It rests upon a ground shaped like a pearl necklace and is covered above by clouds of circular halos from *maṇi*-kings of all precious fragrances.
It is surrounded on all sides by as many world-systems as there are atoms in eighteen buddha-fields, and it is entirely pure.

The Buddha’s name is Supreme Banner of Infinite Expedient Means. Above this, past as many worlds as atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Pure Light Universally Illuminating, which has a limit formed by mani-jewel kings that emit clouds of inexhaustible jewels;
it rests upon Mount Sumerus, oceans, and mountains of infinite colors, fragrances, and flames, and its shape is like a swirling array of precious flowers. By means of... [the text continues].
Above this, covered by a canopy of *indranīla* clouds and king-maṇi jewels radiating light from their edges, are worlds as numerous as the atoms in nineteen buddha-fields surrounding it on all sides;
the Buddha there is named Universal Illumination of the Light of Space Throughout the Dharma Realm.
Beyond this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Wondrous Jewel Flame, adorned with universal radiance, suns, moons, and jewels.
It rests upon a sea of mani-jewel kings in the form of all the celestial beings as its boundary-support;

its appearance is like an array of precious ornaments, covered above by clouds of banners of all kinds of jewel-garments and nets of mani-lamp treasuries, surrounded on all sides by worlds as numerous as the atoms in twenty buddha-fields, being purely and uniformly clear; the Buddha’s name is Merit-Form (Puṇyalakṣaṇa).
O sons of the Buddha, this world-system of Blazing Jewel Radiance, which illuminates the ten directions, contains such vast worlds as these—
numbering as many as the atoms in unspeakably many buddha-fields— each with its own basis of support, each with its own shape, each with its own essential nature,
each with its own orientation, each with its own mode of entry, and each with its own adornments.
Each with its own distinct boundaries, each with its own distinct arrays, each without distinction from the others, and each sustained by its own power,
they surrounded [the central world] on all sides— namely, worlds in the shape of whirlpools as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields,
worlds in the shape of rivers as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields, and worlds in the shape of swirling currents as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields.
Worlds shaped like wheel-rims, as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field; worlds shaped like altars, as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields;
worlds shaped like forests, as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields; worlds shaped like multi-storied pavilions, as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields;
worlds shaped like banners of ethical conduct (*śīla*), as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields; and worlds of universal extent, as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields.
Worlds in the shape of a womb-garbha (*garbha*) as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields; worlds in the shape of a lotus flower as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields;
worlds in the shape of a *kharaka* (a type of vessel) as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields;
worlds in the shapes of various sentient beings as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields; and worlds in the shape of the marks of a Buddha...
There are worlds in the shape of spheres as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields; worlds in the shape of clouds as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields;
worlds in the shape of nets as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields; and worlds in the shape of gate-towers as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields.
Such worlds as these are as many as the atoms in unspeakably many buddha-fields, and each one of these worlds—
Each of these is surrounded by as many vast worlds as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields;
furthermore, each of these worlds has as its retinue as many worlds as there are atoms in the aforementioned [ten] fields.
All these described worlds are situated within this Boundless Exquisite Flower Light Sea of Fragrant Water, and they surround it.
[In] the rivers of fragrant water within the ocean.
[Śāstra: From "At that time" below, up until the end of the fascicle, as well as at the beginning, all the world-systems are summarized;
they are distributed and abide upon this great lotus flower, and furthermore, this central Flower Treasury World-system (*puspa-garbha-loka-dhātu*) is specifically singled out.
Within the ocean there is a world-system named Universal Illumination of Blazing Jewel Radiance in All Directions, consisting of twenty tiers of worlds above and below;
the general meaning therein has already been explained as before.
[Sūtra] At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva again addressed the great assembly, saying:
"O Sons of the Buddha, to the east of this Fragrant Water Sea named Boundless Wondrous Flower Radiance, there is another fragrant water sea called Stainless Flame Treasury.
From it emerges a great lotus named Array of All Fragrant Mani Kings' Sublime Adornments, upon which rests a world-system-seed named Pervasive Illumination."
The world-system *Kṣatra-vartana* has the "Roaring Sound of Bodhisattva Practices" as its essence.
Within it, at the very bottom, is a world named *Palace-Adorned Banner*, which is square in shape and rests upon an ocean adorned with all kinds of jewels.
It is completely covered by clouds of lotus-light nets and is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in a Buddha-field. It is purely and uniformly pure; the Buddha’s name is [as follows].
From the light between his eyebrows, a radiance shone forth, illuminating all the worlds above, passing through as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field.
There is a world named Virtue Flower Treasury (*Guṇakusumagarbha*), which is circular in shape and rests upon an ocean of filaments of all kinds of jewel flowers.

It is completely covered by clouds of lion-throne banners of pearls, and it is surrounded by as many worlds as there are atoms in two buddha-fields. The Buddha there is named All-Non-... [The name is incomplete in the source].
Bianfahaihui, beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field above this place, there is a world named Excellent Transformation of Wondrous Fragrance Wheels.
It is shaped like a vajra and rests upon an ocean of nets of bells adorned with all kinds of jewels.
It is covered above by clouds of variously adorned circular halos, and it is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in three buddha-fields. Buddha... [is there].
Beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field from this world named "Universal Illumination of the Radiance of Meritorious Marks," there is a world named "Exquisite Color Radiance.
Its shape is like a mani-jewel wheel, resting upon an ocean of fragrant water of boundless colored jewels.
It is covered by clouds of pearl pavilions of universal radiance, [as numerous as] the atoms in four buddha-fields.
Surrounded by a multitude of worlds, this single, pure realm is named Good Retinue; the Buddha who appears therein is named Pervasive Illumination.
Above this, past as many worlds as atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Good Canopy, shaped like a lotus flower, resting upon a sea of fragrant water of diamond.
A cloud of fragrance from the water, radiating light free from dust, completely covers its five buddha-fields.
Surrounded by worlds as numerous as atoms, the Buddha there is named Dharma-Joy-Inexhaustible-Wisdom.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Śrī-Puṣpa-Raśmi-Maṇḍala;
it is triangular in shape and rests upon a sea adorned with all kinds of solid jewels. It is completely covered by clouds of light from the bodhisattva-maṇi crowns. Six.
Surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-field, there is a world-system named Pure Universal Radiance; its Buddha is named Pure Universal Radiance.

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-field, there is a world named Jewel Lotus Adornment, shaped like a half-moon, resting upon an ocean adorned with all kinds of lotuses, and completely covered by clouds of all manner of jewel flowers. It is seven Buddha-fields [in extent].
Surrounded by worlds as numerous as atoms, this realm is purely and uniformly adorned; its Buddha is named Pure Eye of Merit-Flowers.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Stainless Flame Adornment.
Its shape is like rows of jewel lamps, resting upon an ocean of jewel-flame treasuries, constantly raining clouds of various bodies and fragrant waters.
It is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in eight buddha-fields, and its Buddha is named Invincible Power of Wisdom.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Wondrous Brahma-Sound, shaped like the svastika (卍), which rests upon an ocean of jewel-cloth banners.

Surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world-system named Vast Eyes Like the Pure Moon in the Sky;
above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Sound of Atoms,
which is shaped like Indra’s net and rests upon an ocean of all kinds of jewel-water, supported by clouds of jewel-canopies that produce every delightful sound.
Above this, it is covered by worlds as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-fields that surround it; it is purely and entirely clear, and its Buddha’s name is Golden Sumeru Lamp.

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Jewel-Colored Adornment, shaped like the svastika, which rests upon an ocean of jewel-kings in the form of Śakra, and is supported by clouds of sun-light flowers.
Covering its summit, it is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in eleven buddha-fields; the Buddha there is named Radiant Wisdom Illuminating the Dharma Realm.

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Golden Sublime Light, shaped like a vast city-walled citadel, resting upon an ocean adorned with all kinds of jewels, serving as a site of enlightenment.

The Buddha there is named Jewel Lamp Universally Illumining Banner. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Universal Radiance Wheel;
it is shaped like a swirling flower and rests upon a sea of revolving jewel-garments, supported by towers of the jewel-king of the Buddhas' voices.
Clouds of palaces cover its summit, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in thirteen buddha-fields, all of which are purely and uniformly clean.
The Buddha there is named Lotus Flame Universal Illumination. Beyond this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Jewel Treasury Adornment;
it is shaped like the four continents and rests upon Mount Sumeru, which is adorned with jewel garlands and possesses jewel-flame light.
The world is surrounded by as many worlds as there are atoms in fourteen buddha-fields, all covered above by clouds of bhikṣuṇīs.
The Buddha there is named Infinite Merit Blooming Flower. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Universal Manifestation Like a Mirror Image;
its form is like that of an asura body, and it rests upon a sea of jewel lotuses supported by vajra.
Crowned by clouds of light and shadows that completely cover its summit, it is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in fifteen buddha-fields;

the Buddha there is named Amṛtasvara. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Candanacandra, which is octagonal in shape and rests upon a sea of *vajra-candana* jewels, covered by clouds of pearl-flower *maṇi* gems.
Above it, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in sixteen Buddha-fields,
is a world-system of uniform purity called Most Victorious Dharma of Peerless Wisdom; above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a Buddha-field,
there is a world named Stainless Radiance, shaped like a whirlpool of fragrant water, resting upon an ocean of jewel-light of boundless colors.
A cloud of exquisite fragrance and radiance covers its summit, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in seventeen buddha-fields.
The Buddha there is named Sound of Radiance Pervading Space. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with Exquisite Flowers;
its shape is like a swirling spiral, resting upon an ocean of all kinds of flowers.
It is covered above by clouds of mani-jewels that resonate with all delightful sounds;
it is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in eighteen buddha-fields. The Buddha there is named Universal Manifestation of Supreme Radiance.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Victorious Sound Adornment; its shape is like a lion throne, resting upon a golden lion.

the Buddha’s name is Boundless Merit Renown Universal Radiance.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Exalted Lamp, shaped like the palm of a Buddha’s hand, resting upon jewels.

It is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in twenty buddha-fields, all of which are purely and uniformly clear. The Buddha there is named Lamp Universally Illuminating Empty Space.

above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Adorned with Myriad Jewels.

the Buddha there is named Supreme Wisdom Great Lion. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Appearance of Lotus Seats;

[Sūtra]: O Sons of the Buddha! To the right of this Lotus Indra-Net Fragrant Water Sea, there is another fragrant water sea, arranged in a clockwise succession.
The ocean is named Accumulated Treasury of Jewel Fragrances; the world-system is named Adorned with All Majestic Virtues, having the sounds of the Dharma-wheels of all Buddhas as its substance.
Within this, at the very bottom, there is a world named Various Manifestations, shaped like a vajra, resting upon various vajra-mountain banners and covered by clouds of vajra-jewel light.
Above this, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, is a world-system of uniform purity called Lotus Eye;
its Buddha is named Producing Joy and Bliss. Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, is a world called Jewel Adorned Banner; its Buddha is... [name missing].

The Buddha’s name is Sarvajñāna (All-Knowing). Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Tārakusumavabhāsa (Universal Illumination of Tārā Flowers), and the Buddha’s name is Vimalaśāntasvaraghoṣa (Stainless Tranquil Wondrous Sound).

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Nirmāṇaprabhā (Light of Transformation), and the Buddha’s name is Viśuddhagaganajñānacandra (Pure Space-Wisdom Moon). Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field...
In worlds as numerous as atoms, there is a world named Array of Various Wonders; the Buddha’s name is Cloud of Manifesting the Ocean of Merit.
Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Exquisite Sound of All Adornments;
the Buddha’s name is Cloud of Joy. Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as atoms of a buddha-field...

There is a world named Lotus Pond; its Buddha is named Banner of Renown. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with All Jewels; its Buddha is named Eye that Observes by Stretching.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Pure and Wondrous Flower; its Buddha is named Inexhaustible Gold.
Kōchi, above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Lotus Adornment City;
the Buddha there is named Universal Radiance of the Sun-Treasury Eye. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Infinite Tree Peaks;
the Buddha there is named Thunderous Sound of All Dharmas. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field... [and so forth].
In worlds as numerous as the atoms of dust, there is a world named Sunlight, where the Buddha is named Revealer of Infinite Wisdom;
above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Resting on Lotus Petals, where the Buddha is named Mountain of All Merit;
above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Wind Pervading.

Holding the Buddha’s name is Ruyao Gen (Root of Solar Radiance). Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Guangming Xianxian (Manifestation of Light), where the Buddha’s name is Shenguang Puzhao (Universal Illumination of Body-Radiance).

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Xiangleiyin Jingangbao Puzhao (Universal Illumination of Fragrant Thunder-Sound Vajra-Jewels), where the Buddha’s name is Zuisheng Huakai Fuxiang (Supreme Flower-Blossoming Appearance).
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Imperial Net Adornment, shaped like a railing and resting upon an ocean of all adornments;
it is completely covered by clouds of flaming pavilions and surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in twenty buddha-fields.
It is purely and uniformly pure, and its Buddha is named Cloud Manifesting Fearlessness.

Sons of the Buddha, to the right of this ocean of fragrant water called Accumulated Treasury of Precious Incense, there is another ocean of fragrant water named Jewel Adornment World System, which is named Universal Stainless. It has as its essence the sounds of the miraculous manifestations of buddha-fields within all atoms.
Within this, at the very bottom, is a world named Pure and Wondrously Level, shaped like a precious body.
It rests upon an ocean of light-wheels of all jewels, covered above by clouds of various sandalwood, mani-jewels, and pearls;
it is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, is purely and uniformly clear, and its Buddha’s name is Invincible Peerless Banner.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, there is a world named Blazing Sublime Adornment.
The Buddha’s name is Padmamatijñānābhijñārāja. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Sūkṣmalakṣaṇacakradhvaja;

the Buddha’s name is Daśadigviśrutānantaprabha. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Jvālāgarbhamaniratnavyūha; the Buddha’s name is... [the text ends here].

Named Great Wisdom, all who see or hear of it rejoice. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with Exquisite Flowers; the Buddha there is named Infinite Power Supreme Wisdom.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Producing Pure Atoms; the Buddha there is named Transcending Superior Brahma.
Above, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Universal Radiance Transformation Fragrance;
the Buddha there is named Fragrant Elephant Vajra Great Powerful Might. Above that, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Radiant Swirl;
the Buddha there is named Accomplished Meaning Good Renown. Above that, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field...
In this world-system is a world named Jewel Garland Ocean; its Buddha is named Incomparable Light Shining Everywhere.
Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Exquisite Flower Lamp Banner;
its Buddha is named Ultimate Merit of Unobstructed Wisdom Lamp. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Good...

The Buddha of Skillful Adornment is named Wisdom-Sun Perfection. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Universal Radiance of Sandalwood Flowers; the Buddha there is named Boundless Wisdom Dharma-Realm Sound.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Imperial Net Banner; the Buddha there is named Transcendent Lamp Light.
Beyond this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Pure Flower Wheel; its Buddha is named Dharma-Realm Sun Radiance.
Beyond this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Great Majestic Radiance;
its Buddha is named Boundless Ocean of Merit Dharma-Wheel Sound. Beyond this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field...
In this world-system, there is a world named Samantavyūha-ratnapadma-saras-tīrtha-vyūha, where the Buddha is named Acintya-jñāna-praveśa-nirdeśaka.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Sama-bhūmi, where the Buddha is named Guṇaratna-prabhāsa-rāja.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world...
The world-realm is named Fragrant Jewel Cluster; the Buddha’s name is Ocean of Inexhaustible Merit, Subtle Adornment.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world-realm named Subtle Radiance; the Buddha’s name is Peerless Power, Universal Sound.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world-realm named Universally Solid in the Ten Directions.
Its form is firmly adorned and radiant, resting upon a heart-king maṇi-wheel ocean with eight corners.
It is covered above by clouds of canopies adorned with all kinds of jewels, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in twenty buddha-fields. This realm is purely and uniformly serene;
the Buddha’s name is Universal Eye Great Bright Lamp. O Children of the Buddha, this is the Fragrant Water Ocean Adorned with Jewels.
To the right, there is a fragrant water sea named Vajraratnasaṃcaya;
its world-system is named Dharmadhātucaryā, which has as its essence the sounds of the Dharma-voice of the skillful means of all bodhisattva stages.
At the very bottom of this [sea] is a world named Pure Light Radiance, shaped like a string of pearls, resting upon an ocean of pearl tassels of every precious color. Bodhisattvas dwell therein.
Above this, covered by clouds of mani-jewels with radiant topknots, is a world surrounded by as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, which is purely and entirely clear;
its Buddha’s name is Light of Supreme Merit. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Wondrous Canopy;
its Buddha’s name is Wisdom of Dharma Sovereignty. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field...
Beyond a number of worlds, there is a world named Ratnavyūhasiṃhāsana; the Buddha there is named Mahānāgahradā.
Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Vajrāsanodbhava; the Buddha there is named Abhyudgatasiṃhāsanapadmagarbha.
Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named...
Above this world, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Excellent Lotus Sound; its Buddha’s name is Wisdom Light Universally Awakening.
Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Well-Practiced; its Buddha’s name is King of Sublime Radiance Sustaining the Earth.
Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, is a world named Joyful Sound; its Buddha’s name is King of the Lamp of Dharma. Above this...
In worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Maṇigarbha-Indrājāla; its Buddha is named Amoghadarśin.
Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Citraratnagarbha;
its Buddha is named Jvālākāyadhvaja. Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named...

Beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field above the world where the Buddha Golden Light Wheel resides—whose name is Purifying the Conduct of Sentient Beings—there is a world named Adorned by Mount Sumeru; its Buddha is named Universal Illumination of All Merit Clouds.
Beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field above that, there is a world named Form of Many Trees; its Buddha is named Jewel Flower Mark.
Vimalacandra, beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field above this, there is a world named Abhayā where the Buddha is named Jyotirāja-vara-suvarṇa-śikhin.

Beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field above that, there is a world named Mahāyaśo-nāgendra-dhvaja where the Buddha is named Sarva-dharma-samadarśin. Beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field above that...
In worlds as numerous as atoms of dust, there is a world named Manifestation of Maṇi Colors; the Buddha there is named Transformation Sun.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with Flaming Lamps;
the Buddha there is named Jewel Canopy Light Pervading All. Above this, past worlds as numerous as atoms of a buddha-field, there is a world named Fragrant Light.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Cloud of Wisdom through Contemplation;

its Buddha is named Ocean of the Supreme Wisdom of Diligence. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Banner of Light from All Adornments; its Buddha is named Lotus that Universally Manifests Delight.
"Lord of Sovereignty, above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Adorned with the Tuft-mark (*ūrṇā-kośa-vyūha*).
It is shaped like a half-moon and rests upon a sea of *maṇi* flowers on Mount Sumeru.
It is covered by clouds of *maṇi* kings of blazing light from all adornments, and it is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in twenty buddha-fields."

The Buddha of Pure Unity is named Pure Eye. O Sons of the Buddha, to the right of this ocean of fragrant water called the Mass of Vajra Jewels, there is another ocean of fragrant water named Celestial City Jewel Ramparts.

Its world-system is named Lamp Flame Radiance, and it is characterized by the sound of the universal manifestation of the wheel of Dharma of equality. Within this, at the very bottom, there is a world.

The world-system named Jewel Moonlight Flame-Wheel, shaped like all manner of ornaments and resting upon a sea of flowers adorned with every kind of jewel, is covered by clouds of lion-thrones the color of lapis lazuli.

It is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, is uniformly pure, and its Buddha is named Sun-Moon Sovereign Light. Beyond this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field...
Beyond a number of worlds, there is a world named Sumeru Jewel Light, where the Buddha is named Inexhaustible Dharma-Jewel Banner.
Above this, past as many worlds as atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Multitude of Wondrous Radiance Banners, where the Buddha is named Great Flower Cluster.
Above this, past as many worlds as atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Mani Radiance.

Above the world-system where the Buddha is named Manuṣyāgra-svayambhū (Self-Existent Foremost Among Men), past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Samanta-nirghoṣa (Universal Sound);
its Buddha is named Sarvajña-vyāpi-prabhāsa (Omniscient Pervasive Illumination).

Above that, past as many worlds as there are atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Mahādruma-kinnara-nirghoṣa (Sound of the Great Tree Kinnara); its Buddha is named Ananta-puṇya-vaśitā-nāga (Dragon of Infinite Meritorious Sovereignty).
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Boundless Pure Radiance;
the Buddha there is named Jewel Flower Light of Virtue. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Supreme Sound;
the Buddha there is named Adorned with All-Knowledge. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field...
There is a world named Adorned with Various Jewels, where the Buddha is named Jewel Flame Sumeru Mountain.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Pure Sumeru Sound, where the Buddha is named Manifesting the Light of All Practices.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Fragrant Water Canopy.

The Buddha’s name is Unobstructed Ocean of All Pāramitās. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Lion Flower Net; the Buddha’s name is Jewel Flame Banner.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Vajra Wondrous Flower Lamp; the Buddha’s name is Light of All Great Vows.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Ground of Radiance of All Dharmas;

the Buddha there is named Vast True Meaning of All Dharmas. Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, there is a world named Even Adornment of Pearl Dust; the Buddha there is named Net of Supreme Wisdom Radiance. Above this...
In worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, there is a world named Vaidūrya-flower, where the Buddha is named Ratnakūṭadhvaja.

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, there is a world named Immeasurable Sublime Light Circle, where the Buddha is named Great Majestic Power Ocean-Treasury of Wisdom.
Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field, there is a world named...
Clearly seeing the Buddha of the ten directions named Banner of All Purified Virtues; above this, past as many worlds as atoms in a buddha-field,
there is a world named Delightful Brahma-Sound, shaped like a Buddha’s hand, resting upon a sea of jewel-light nets,
covered by clouds of all the adornments of the bodies of bodhisattvas, [extending for] twenty buddha-fields of atoms.
Numerous worlds surround it, forming a single, pure realm; the Buddha’s name is Unobstructed Light Universally Illuminating the Dharma Realm.
[Treatise] Tenth: This ninth fascicle of the sutra contains ten sets of twentyfold world-systems surrounding this central world-system;
in total, there are eleven sets of twentyfold world-systems within them.
The underlying intention has already been explained previously.
[Sūtra] At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva again addressed the great assembly, saying:

"O Sons of the Buddha, to the east of the Fragrant Water Sea named 'Stainless Radiant Treasury' (Vimalajvālakośa), there is another Fragrant Water Sea named 'Subtle Transformation Body' (Vikurvitamanojña-kāya). Within this sea, there is a world..."
The world-system is named Well-Arrayed Distinctions; next is a sea of fragrant water named Vajra-Eye Banner, and the world-system is named Bridge Adorning the Dharma-Dhātu;

next is a sea of fragrant water named Exquisite Array of Various Lotuses, and the world-system is named Constantly Producing Transformations in the Ten Directions; next is a sea of fragrant water named Uninterrupted Jewel King.
Next is a world-system called Jewel Lotus Stem Dense Cloud, followed by a fragrant water ocean named Wondrous Fragrance Flame Universal Adornment;
next is a world-system called Vairocana’s Manifested Conduct, followed by a fragrant water ocean named Jewel Powder Jambu Banner;
next is a world-system called the Realm of the Buddhas’ Protective Mindfulness, followed by a fragrant water ocean.
The world-system is named Blazing Light of All Forms; the world-system is named Supreme Light Pervading Illumination;
next there is a sea of fragrant water named Realm of All Adornments; the world-system is named Jewel Flame Lamp.
There are seas of fragrant water such as these, as numerous as the atoms in unspeakably many Buddha-fields. The sea of fragrant water closest to the Cakravāḍa mountain range is named...
In the world-system called *Phalada*, which takes as its essence the sound of the eon of purification of the ocean of worlds and the constant emission of light,
there is at the very bottom a world named *Priyadarśana-vimalaprabhā-ketu*.
It is surrounded by as many worlds as there are atoms in a Buddha-field, is purely and uniformly pure, and the Buddha there is named *Vijaya-samādhi-vīrya-mati*.

Above, past as many worlds as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields, at the same level as the world Vajradhvaja, there is a world named Gandhavicitradhvaja surrounded by as many worlds as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields;
it is purely and entirely pure, and its Buddha is named Unobstructed Lamp of the Dharma-realm. Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in three buddha-fields, with...
In the Sahā world, there is a world system named Equal and Even, which has a world called Radiant Treasury; its Buddha is named Unobstructed Wisdom Illuminating the Entire Dharma Realm.
Above this, passing through as many worlds as there are atoms in seven buddha-fields, one reaches this world-system.
At the very top of this world-system is a world named Supreme Body Fragrance, surrounded by as many worlds as there are atoms in twenty buddha-fields.

Surrounding the single, pure Buddha-field named *Bodhyanga-kusuma*, O sons of the Buddha, beyond the ocean of fragrant water called *Ananta-prabhā-maṇḍala*, there is an ocean of fragrant water named *Sampūrṇa-sudhā-prabhā*; its world-system is named *Samantavimala*.
Beyond that, there is an ocean of fragrant water named *Prabhāsa-cchatra*; its world-system is named *Ananta-samantālaṃkāra*. Beyond that...
There is a sea of fragrant water named *Wondrous Jewel Adornment*, whose world-system is named *Fragrant Maṇi Array*.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named *Producing the Buddha’s Voice*, whose world-system is named *Well-Established Adornment*.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named *Fragrant Banner Sumeru Treasury*, whose world-system is named *Pervasive Radiance*. Next, there is a sea of fragrant water...
There is an ocean named Sandalwood Exquisite Radiance, and its world-system is named Flower Flame Wheel.
Next, there is a fragrant water ocean named Sustained by Wind Power, and its world-system is named Jewel Flame Cloud Banner.
Next, there is a fragrant water ocean named Śakra’s Body Adornment, and its world-system is named Pearl Treasury. Next, there is a fragrant water ocean named Level, Pure, and Adorned.
The world-systems within these fragrant water oceans— adorned with various kinds of lapis lazuli sands and so forth, as numerous as the atoms in unspeakably many Buddha-fields—
are such that the fragrant water ocean nearest to the Cakravāḍa mountains is named *Miośuhua* (Exquisite Tree Flower).
Its world-system is named *Chushengzhufangguangdachachan* (Birth of Vast and Great Lands in All Directions), and it has as its essence the sound of all Buddhas subduing Māras.
At the very bottom of this [array] is a world named Flame-Torch Banner; its Buddha is named Ocean of Worldly Merits.
Above this, passing through as many worlds as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields, at the same level as the Vajra Banner world, is a world named Birth of Jewels;
its Buddha is named Lion-Force Jewel Cloud. Above this, it is level with the Sahā world.
There is a world named Vastra-dhvaja, where the Buddha is named Sarvajñāna-sāgara-rāja.
Above this world-system, at the very summit, there is a world named Ratna-avataṃsaka-siṃha-prabha, where the Buddha is named Su-vikurvaṇa-padma-dhvaja.
O Sons of the Buddha, beyond that Vajra-jvālā-prabhā ocean of fragrant water, there is another ocean of fragrant water named...
The world-system of the fragrant ocean named Adorned with All Ornamented Banners is called Pure Conduct Adornment;
next, the world-system of the fragrant ocean named Radiance of All Jewel Flowers is called Adornment of Merit Marks;
next, the world-system of the fragrant ocean named Blooming Lotus is called Adornment of the Bodhisattva’s Mani Crown.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Exquisite Jewel Garments; its world-system is named Pure Pearl Circle.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Delightful Flowers Illumining Everywhere; its world-system is named Radiance of the Clouds of a Hundred Lights.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Great Light Pervading Space; its world-system is named Universal Illumination of Jewel Light. Next, there is a sea of fragrance...
The ocean of water named Wondrous Flower Adorned Banner has a world-system named Golden Moon-Eye Necklace;
next is the fragrant water-ocean named Pearl Fragrance Sea-Treasury with a world-system named Buddha Radiance;
next is the fragrant water-ocean named Jewel Wheel Radiance with a world-system named Light of the Skillful Manifestation of the Buddha’s Realm; such are these [oceans and systems].
There are oceans of fragrant water, as numerous as the atoms in unspeakably many Buddha-fields.
The ocean of fragrant water nearest to the Cakravāḍa mountains is named Boundless Wheel Adorned Base;

its world-system is named Infinite Variations of Distinctions, which has as its essence the various sounds of speech from all lands. Within this, at the very bottom, there is a world named Vajra Flower.

The Buddha’s name is Infinite Marks Radiance Universal Gate Sound. Ten world-systems as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field above this have a world-system equal in extent to the Vajradhvaja world, named Birth of Jewel-Raiment Banner;
its Buddha’s name is Merit Cloud Great Majestic Power. Ten world-systems as numerous as the atoms of a buddha-field above this have a world-system equal in extent to the Sahā world, named...
In this world-system, above the highest point of the lineage of worlds, there is a world named Sunlight Garment Banner;

its Buddha is named Ocean of Supreme Wisdom. Furthermore, O sons of the Buddha, beyond the fragrant water ocean adorned with sapphire jewels, there is another fragrant water ocean named Palace of the Asuras.

There is a world-system named Fragrant Water Light Sustained; next is a fragrant water ocean named Jewel Lion Adornment, and a world-system named Universally Manifesting All Jewels of the Ten Directions;
next is a fragrant water ocean named Palace-Colored Radiant Cloud, and a world-system named Wondrous Adornment of Jewel Wheels; next is a fragrant water ocean named Producing Great...

The world-system seed named Wondrous Adornment Pervading the Dharma Realm; next, there is a fragrant water ocean named Lamp Flame Wondrous Eye, whose world-system seed is named Universal Observation of the Transformations of the Ten Directions;
next, there is a fragrant water ocean named Inconceivable Adornment Wheel, whose world-system seed is named Universal Renown of the Radiance of the Ten Directions; next, there is a fragrance...
There is a sea of water named Jewel-Heap Adornment; its world-system is named Lamp-Illumination.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Pure Jewel Radiance; its world-system is named Sumeru Unobstructed Wind.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Jewel-Garment Balustrade; its world-system is named Tathāgata-Body Radiance. Such as these are...
One may speak of as many oceans of fragrant water as there are atoms in a Buddha-field;
the ocean of fragrant water nearest to the Cakravāḍa mountains is named Tree-Adorned Banner, and its world-system is named Abiding Imperial Net.
It has as its essence the sounds of the stages of wisdom of all bodhisattvas. Within it, at the very bottom, is a world named Wondrous Golden Color, where the Buddha is named Fragrant Flame Victory.

Above this world of Majestic Radiance, past as many worlds as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields, there is a world level with the world of Vajradhvaja named Maṇivṛkṣapuṣpa; its Buddha is named Unobstructed Universal Manifestation.
Above this, level with the Sahā world, there is a world named Vaidūryasudarśanavyūha; its Buddha is named Dharma-vaśitā-dṛḍha.
"Solid Wisdom, at the very summit of this world-system, there is a world named Brahma-Sound Sublime Adornment, where the Buddha is named Lotus-Blossom Radiant King.

O Sons of the Buddha, beyond that Fragrant Water Sea adorned with a Vajra-Wheel Foundation, there is another Fragrant Water Sea named Manifestation of Lotus-Flowers; its world-system is named Level Lands."
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Maṇiprabha; its world-system is named Pervading the Dharma Realm Without Confusion.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Various Wondrous Fragrances and Sun-Maṇi; its world-system is named Universally Manifesting in the Ten Directions.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Constantly Receiving the Flow of Jewels; its world-system is named Universally Practicing the Buddha’s Speech.
There is a sea of fragrant water named Boundless Profound and Wondrous Sound; its world-system is named Boundless Variety of Directions.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Solid Accumulation; its world-system is named Infinite Varieties of Places.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Pure Brahma-Sound; its world-system is named Universally Pure Adornment. Next, there is a sea of fragrance...

Next, there is a fragrant water-ocean named Adorned with the Light of the King of Wondrous Fragrant Jewels; the world-system is named Power of Universally Manifesting Radiance.
O Sons of the Buddha, beyond that Lotus Indra-Net fragrant water-ocean, there is a fragrant water-ocean named Silver.

next is the fragrant water ocean named Vaidūrya Bamboo Dense Flame Cloud, whose world-system is named Universally Producing Sounds from the Ten Directions;

Its world-system is named Sarvālokavyūha, which has as its essence the sounds of the assemblies at the sites of enlightenment of all Tathāgatas.
At the very bottom of this [system] is a world named Viśuddhacakṣurvyūha, where the Buddha is named Vajracandraprabhāsa-vyāpin. 10.
Above this, past as many worlds as there are atoms in ten buddha-fields, there is a world equal in extent to the world Vajradhvaja;
its name is Padmaguṇa and its Buddha is named Mahāvīryasujñāna.

the Buddha there is named Peerless Majestic Virtue Unconquerable by Any. O Sons of the Buddha!
Beyond that Accumulated Precious Incense Treasury Fragrant Water Sea, there is a fragrant water sea named Universal Illumination of All Jewel Radiance, and its world-system is named Stainless.

Following the ocean of fragrant water named Adornment, there is an ocean of fragrant water named World-System of Blooming Multitudes of Jeweled Flowers, whose world-system type is called Space-like Appearance.
Following that, there is an ocean of fragrant water named Auspicious Canopy Illuminating Everywhere, whose world-system type is called Universal Adornment of Unobstructed Light.
Following that, there is an ocean of fragrant water named Sandalwood Tree Flower, whose world-system type is called Universally Manifesting in the Ten Directions.
Next in sequence was a sea of fragrant water named Birth of the World-System of Wondrously Colored Jewels, called Victorious Banner Pervasive Everywhere;
next was a sea of fragrant water named Universal Birth of Vajra Flowers, called Manifesting Inconceivable Adornments;
next was a sea of fragrant water named Heart-King Maṇi-Wheel Ornamentation, called Showing... [the world-system].
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Manifesting the Unobstructed Light of Buddhas;
its world-system is named Accumulated Jewel Garlands, and its world-sphere is named Purifying Doubts. Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Universal Adornment of Pearl Wheels;
its world-system is named Flowing from the Vows of All Buddhas. Such seas of fragrant water are as numerous as the atoms in unspeakably many buddha-fields.

Recently, in the world-system called Universal Sound Banner, which is located within the Fragrant Ocean of Mount Cakravāḍa and belongs to the world-realm called Jambūnada Jewel-Treasury Wheel, there exists a world at its very lowest level named Flower Pistil Flame.

Equal in extent to the world-system Vajradhvaja is a world-system named Padmaprabhādhvaja; its Buddha is named Sarvaguṇasāgravicintitacittarāja.

it is named Daśabalavyūha, and its Buddha is named Anantaprabhāsasamudgata.
Within this world-system, at the very summit of the array of worlds, there is a world named Maṇi-gandha-kūṭa-dhvaja;

the Buddha there is named Vipula-sunetra-vimala-vicikitsā-prahāṇa. O Sons of the Buddha, beyond that Ratna-vyūha fragrant-water ocean, there is another fragrant-water ocean named Sumeru-dhara-prabhā-garbha, and its world-system is named Vipula-sambhava.

next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Supported by All Jewel Adornments.

next is a world-system named Abode of Jewel Flowers, which has a fragrant ocean named Utmost Wisdom Conduct;
next is a world-system named Adornment of Supreme Forms, which has a fragrant ocean named Universal... [The text continues with further world-systems and oceans].

Beyond that is a fragrant water ocean named Filled with Delightful Mani Jewels Pervasive Illumination;

Recently, from the fragrant ocean at the Cakravāḍa Mountains, there emerged the name of a world-system called Universal Pervasiveness Without Differentiation, which has the thundering roar of all bodhisattvas as its essence.

At the very bottom of this system is a world named Exquisite Victorious Treasury, where the Buddha is named Supreme Virtue and Wisdom. Above this, past as many buddha-fields as there are atoms in ten [buddha-fields],...
Equal to the world Vajradhvaja is a world named Vyūhalakṣaṇa, where the Buddha is named Atiśayamahāprabha.
Above this, equal to the Sahā world, is a world named Vaiḍūryamaṇḍala-samantavyūha, where the Buddha is named Sumerupradīpa. At the very top of this world-system is a world named...
O Sons of the Buddha, beyond the fragrant water ocean named Flower Banner, there is a Buddha named Inexhaustible Transformation of Wondrous Wisdom Clouds.
Beyond that Fragrant Water Ocean of Jewel Mass, there is another fragrant water ocean named Adorned with Exalted Jewel Ramparts;
its world-system is named Outstanding Jewel Banner. Beyond that, there is a fragrant water ocean named Jewel Banner Adornment; its world-system is named Manifesting All.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Radiance of Light; its world-system is named Adorned with All Jewels and Illuminated by Radiance.
Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Adorned with Flowers of Jewel Trees; its world-system is named Interspersed with Wondrous Flowers.

Next, there is a sea of fragrant water named Lotus Universal Adornment; its world-system is named Boundless Shore Ocean Abyss. Next, there is a sea of fragrant water...
The ocean of water is named Adorned with Exquisite Jewels, and the world-system is named Treasury of Universally Manifesting Lands.
There are as many such oceans of fragrant water as there are atoms in unspeakably many Buddha-fields.
The ocean of fragrant water nearest the Cakravāḍa mountains is named Indestructible Ocean, and its world-system is named Lotus Field Interspersed with Exquisite Wheels. By all Buddhas...
The essence of this consists of sounds produced by power. At the very bottom of this [array] is a world named Most Exquisite Fragrance;

the Buddha there is named Manifestation of Infinite Atom-like Rays. Above this, passing through as many worlds as atoms in ten buddha-fields, at the same level as the world Vajradhvaja, there is a world named Inconceivable Gate of Differentiated Adornments; its Buddha is named...
Above this Immeasurable Wisdom [Palace], level with the Sahā world, there is a world named Ten Directions Radiance Exquisite Flower Treasury;
the Buddha’s name is Lion Eye Light Flame Cloud. At this highest point above, there is a world named Ocean Sound;
the Buddha’s name is Water Deity Light Flame Gate. O Sons of the Buddha! There, in that celestial city, are jewel battlements and fragrant waters.
Beyond that, there is a sea of fragrant water named Blazing Wheel Radiant Light; its world-system is named Inexpressible Various Adornments.
Beyond that, there is a sea of fragrant water named Path of Jewel Dust; its world-system is named Universally Entering Infinite Spirals.

In the next grid square is a sea of fragrant water named All Drum and Music Exquisite Sound; its world-system is named Perfectly Level and Even.

In these incalculable oceans of fragrant water—equal in number to the atoms within unspeakably many Buddha-fields, such as those of various forms—the ocean of fragrant water nearest to the Cakravāḍa mountains is named Accumulated Garlands and Robes.

Its world-system is called Manifestation of Wondrous Garments, and its substance consists of the vocal sounds of all Buddhas of the three periods of time. Within this, at the very lowest point, there is an ocean of fragrant water.
The world-system named Indrarāja-padmagarbha is surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in a Buddha-field of "Arisen Joy.
It is purely uniform and its Buddha is named Firmly Awakened Wisdom. Above this, passing through worlds as numerous as the atoms in ten Buddha-fields, it is level with the world-system Vajradhvaja.
There is a world there named Jewel Net Adornment. Ten Buddha-fields... [the text continues].
Surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-field, this realm is purely and uniformly pure; its Buddha is named Infinite Joy Light.

Above this, past worlds as numerous as the atoms in three buddha-fields, there is a world equal in extent to the Sahā world, named Jewel Lotus Lion Throne, surrounded by worlds as numerous as the atoms in thirteen buddha-fields; its Buddha is named...
Most Pure and Not Empty, having heard this, passed beyond worlds as numerous as the atoms in seven Buddha-fields and arrived at the highest point of this world-system.
